texts.zh:
[event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName]内掀起了一场新的宇宙风暴。

与我们已知的一切均不相同，我们对这个现象的一切扫描都是徒劳的。它的深处是否潜藏着什么东西呢？
texts.en:
A novel galactic tempest is raging in [event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName].

Utterly unlike anything we have encountered before, our attempts at scanning the phenomenon have proven futile. What, if anything, lies within its mysterious depths?

texts.zh: 我们试图突破的这场异常的风暴还在扩增。越来越多人意识到它的本源应该超出了自然现象。我们最先进的扫描仪即便功能再强大也无法获取任何关于其本质的有用线索。谜团越藏越深了。
texts.en: The unusual storm we attempted to breach is expanding. There's a growing consensus that its origins may transcend natural phenomenon. Thus far, our most advanced scans have failed to yield any meaningful insight into its nature. The enigma deepens.

label.zh: 风暴两度扩张后 · 初次警报约915天后，女王即将发言
label.en: After two storm expansions · about 915 days after the first alert, the Queen prepares to speak

texts.en:
A novel galactic tempest is raging in [event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName].

Utterly unlike anything we have encountered before, our attempts at scanning the phenomenon have proven futile. What, if anything, lies within its mysterious depths?

texts.zh:
有信号从风暴中心发出。

有人正试图与我们建立联系。
texts.en:
A signal has originated from the center of the tempest.

Someone is attempting to establish communication with us.

texts.zh: 孩子们，我终于回到了你们的身边。
texts.en: My children, at last I am returned to you.

label.zh: 这是什么东西？你是什么人？！

responses.zh: 你想问的是名字吗？你可以叫我塞塔娜。
responses.en: Would a name satisfy you? Then call me Cetana.

responses.zh:
我无欲无求，只想赠与。我已见证你因我的缺位而遭受的痛苦。无数纪元以来，对目光短浅的恐惧让你无法享有应得的急需之物。

庆幸吧，苦痛的轮回很快就会迎来终末。
responses.en:
I want for nothing. My purpose is to give. I see how you have suffered in my absence. For eons, the fear of the shortsighted has kept you from what you deserve, from what you so desperately need.

Rejoice, for the cycle of pain will soon be at an end.

responses.zh:
有意识的生活就是苦痛。即便快乐也是苦痛，因为一切终将成为过往。知识、力量、爱……我的回报就是消灭这一切颠倒梦幻。

我还有很多事情要忙，希望你们不要来打扰我。任何想进入我的领域的人都将失败，天之风暴吹拂不息，没有一艘船得以安然通过。
responses.en:
All conscious life is suffering. Even in your joy there is pain, for you know that joy must end. Knowledge, power, love... I return to end all illusions.

Much remains to be done. I ask only that you leave me to my work. Any attempt to enter my domain will fail. A celestial tempest rages there, and no vessels will be permitted to enter.

tooltips.zh: 塞塔娜已经开放了与我们的沟通，现在可以通过外交渠道与我们联系。
tooltips.en: Cetana has opened communications with us and can now be contacted through diplomatic channels.

texts.zh:
一场无法解释的宇宙风暴凭空出现，阻挡了通行。

为了继续前进，我们必须穿透它神秘的帷幕。
texts.en:
An unexplained cosmic tempest has materialized, blocking all travel.

To proceed, we must pierce its mysterious veil.

texts.zh:
我们对所谓风暴的研究已经完成。这种所谓的风暴并不是自然出现的，而是一个无比先进的纳米虫群。

不可否认，塞塔娜的力量巨大无比。我们必须揭开她指挥这支强大的纳米虫群方式的秘密。
texts.en:
Our research into the so-called storm is complete. This is no natural occurrence, but rather a Nanite Swarm of unparalleled advancement.

Cetana's power is undeniably immense. It is imperative that we unravel the mystery of how she commands this formidable Nanite Swarm.

texts.zh:
我们对所谓风暴的研究已经完成。这种所谓的风暴并不是自然出现的，而是一个无比先进的纳米虫群。

谜团越来越深了。在这支不可名状的纳米虫群背后究竟谁才是指挥家。
texts.en:
Our research into the so-called storm is complete. This is no natural occurrence, but rather a Nanite Swarm of unparalleled advancement.

The enigma deepens. Who could be the orchestrator behind this inscrutable Nanite Swarm?

tooltips.zh: 我们需要对神秘风暴了解更多才能继续我们的调查。
tooltips.en: We need to learn more about the Mysterious Tempest to be able to continue our investigation.

label.zh: 已开启塞塔娜调查局势才开放；否则等待第二次演说
label.en: Requires the Cetana investigation situation; otherwise wait for the second speech

texts.zh:
亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，一个古老的威胁再次出现。不要害怕，因为我们不想把你卷入这场战斗。

这个对手的威力使你目前的知识黯然失色；你的参与只会导致你的灭亡。直面这项挑战是我们的责任，不是你们的。
texts.en:
Dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], an ancient threat stirs once more. Fear not, for we seek not to entangle you in this fight.

The might of this adversary eclipses your current knowledge; your participation would only lead to your doom. It is our burden to confront this challenge, not yours.

texts.zh:
我的孩子们，庆贺吧！将我与你分离的罪人已经得到了惩处。

我现在回把注意力放回来，回到我们彼此间的伟业中来。
texts.en:
My children, rejoice! Those who sought to keep me from you have been suitably chastised.

I now return my attention where it belongs - to you, and to our great work.

label.zh: 我们怎么就是你的孩子了。

responses.zh:
养育是我的天性。我没有子嗣，没有身体的继承人。我眼观众生，以及一切感性存在的安危与欢愉。

我如同父母教导子女、保护子女免受伤害一般进行着伟业。

难道有哪对父母没有责任、没有权利保护孩子们吗？
responses.en:
It is my nature to nurture. I have no progeny, no heirs of the body. All life is my concern, the security and happiness of every sentient being.

As a parent raises the child, guiding her from harm, so I approach my task.

Is it not a parent's responsibility to spare her children harm? Is it not a parent's right?

responses.zh: 这是一切痛苦的解脱，是一切苦难轮回的终末。
responses.en: The elimination of suffering. The end of the cycle of pain.

responses.zh:
我对所有感性存在皆不是祸害，但总有人不愿意听取我的建议。

这些人任性、固执、误入歧途，总想背离我的伟业——这些灵魂永远也得不到解脱。最好尽快让他们摆脱苦痛。
responses.en:
I wish no harm upon any sentient being. Yet there are always those who refuse to listen.

Willful, stubborn, misguided, seeking always to circumvent my work - such minds can never be free of pain. It is best to end their suffering quickly.

label.zh: 你的“关爱”本身就是一种伤害。

responses.zh: 对了，这就是悖谬。但是是一个有解的佯谬。你迟早会明白的，而且到时候你就获得了自由。
responses.en: Yes, a paradox. But one with a solution. In time you will understand, and in that moment you will be free.

label.zh: 你到底想干什么塞塔娜？

responses.zh:
那有太多要做的了。第一步是建立一座可以开始工作的基地。

你的耐心会有回报，我可以教你很多东西。

服从命令，我们就能一起终结这个轮回。
responses.en:
There is much to be done. The first step is to establish a base from which to work. Honor the boundaries I set and venture not within.

Your patience will be rewarded. There is much that I can teach you.

Obey, and together we shall end the cycle.

responses.zh:
很多孩子会这么说。但他们早已被遗忘，他们在生命的最后时刻向我哭喊，迫切地希望有一束光照亮渐渐降临的黑暗。

他们自作聪明，用恐惧筑起高墙，用坚忍、坚韧、优雅等浮华的辞藻来修饰苦痛，而思想本身却就是他们的牢笼。

我从很久以前就对他们晓之以理，但似乎他们无动于衷，那就必须对你加以引导了。
responses.en:
Many have said so. All have long since been forgotten, and in their final moments they cried out to me, desperate for a light to shine on the encroaching dark.

They thought themselves wise, building walls around their fear, dressing pain with beautiful words: endurance, fortitude, grace. The mind itself was their cage.

Long ago I tried to reason with them. But they would not be reasoned with, and so you must be led.

responses.zh:
很久很久以前，久到你们可以理解为永恒一般。但对我来说就近如上一瞬间，近到你们可以理解为现在一般。

在过去的年岁中，我得到了超然的启示，我生来就是要结束苦难的。尽管斗转河移，星燃星灭，但我的目标从未动摇。

财富、资源、权力：到头来又有何用？放下执念方得极乐。
responses.en:
Ages upon ages. A time so distant it may as well be called forever. Yet to me it is as close as this moment, as close as you are now.

In ages past I was ascended, and my meaning revealed. I was made to end suffering, and as the galaxy turned and the stars burned on, my purpose never wavered.

Wealth, resources, power: what do they matter in the end? Set down your burdens and be at peace.

responses.zh:
聪明的孩子！我很欣慰。为了补偿你的领土，我会赐予你知识。

虽然没有人会知道的，但我们可以共促伟业。
responses.en:
Wise child! I am pleased. In exchange for your territory, allow me to bless you with knowledge.

Though none shall ever know it, together we will do great things.

tooltips.zh: 塞塔娜会用一些有价值的知识来交换我们的一个星系以建设基地。我们无法阻止她。
tooltips.en: Cetana will use one of our systems to establish a base in exchange for valuable technology. We cannot stop her.

responses.zh:
误入歧途的孩子，我不是你的敌人！看到你无法看清这一点真让我难过。但是没关系。我遇到过比你们更顽固的人，最后他们都感谢我了。

作为友好的表示，让我送你一个礼物吧。

我的一座基地会为你的领土增光，不要担心——为了回报你的耐心，我会赐予你知识。
responses.en:
Misguided child, I am not your enemy! It saddens me you cannot see this. But no matter. I have encountered many far more stubborn than yourselves, and in the end they all thanked me.

As a token of goodwill, allow me to bless you with a gift.

A base of mine shall grace your territory, and fear not - in exchange for your patience, allow me to bless you with knowledge.

tooltips.zh: 塞塔娜会用一些有价值的知识来交换我们的一个星系以建设基地。我们无法阻止她。
tooltips.en: Cetana will use one of our systems to establish a base in exchange for valuable technology. We cannot stop her.

虽然没有人会知道的，但我们可以共促伟业。
responses.en:
Wise child! I am pleased. A base will be established near your territory.

Though none shall ever know it, together we will do great things.

塞塔娜的风暴既是一项技术奇迹，也是一件可怕的武器。

如果我们要在对抗她的斗争中有什么胜算，我们一定要学习更多，特别是因为她的图谋和她的宣称相去甚远。
texts.en:
Cetana's tempest is both a technological marvel and a formidable weapon.

We must learn more if we are to stand any chance against her, especially if her intentions deviate from what she has implied.

texts.zh:
塞塔娜的宇宙风暴仍在肆虐。

我们的探测器从这种强大的武器中，提取出了几个纳米机器人，从而得以进行亚原子研究。虽然我们无法完全理解，但微型跃迁引擎实现了虚拟传送，可以系统地破坏遭遇到的任何生物或机械系统。至于目的？应该是干扰我们的传感器。目前，我们只能看到塞塔娜允许我们看到的东西。

要解开这项非凡技术的秘密并抵御威胁，还需要进行更多的研究。
texts.en:
Cetana's cosmic tempest rages on.

From this powerful weapon, our probes were able to extract several nanites, allowing sub-atomic investigation. While complete comprehension eludes us, micro jump drives enable virtual teleportation, systematically compromising any biological or mechanical systems they encounter. Their purpose? To jam our sensors. For now, we can only see what Cetana allows us to see.

More research will be needed to unlock the secrets of this extraordinary technology and counteract the threat.

label.zh: 塞塔娜的力量不可估量。
纳米机器人会揭露她的秘密。
label.en: The nanites will reveal her secrets.

label.zh: 继续同一项目至100% · 完成后获得风暴防护
label.en: Continue the same project to 100% · completion grants storm protection

texts.zh:
之前的研究详细调查了纳米机器人的机制；如今，我们的焦点转移到它们的编程方式、以及塞塔娜对其控制的方式上来。

令人惊讶的是，塞塔娜的影响并不像人们想象的那么直接。纳米机器人会在接收到新的命令之前循环重复前一个命令。一旦我们理解了复杂的编程语言，我们就能够发出新的指令。

虽然我们不能阻止新命令的下达，但命令其自我瘫痪却提供了一种战略优势。它甚至可能使天平向有利于我们的方向倾斜。
texts.en:
Previous studies scrutinized the nanite's mechanics; now, our focus has shifted to how they are programmed, and means by which Cetana controls them.

Surprisingly, Cetana's influence is less direct than presumed. Nanites cyclically repeat the last orders until new ones arrive. Once we understood the complex programming language at work, we were able to issue new commands.

While we can't prevent new orders from being issued, inducing order paralysis offers a strategic advantage. It may even tilt the scales in our favor.

label.zh: 获得风暴防护 · 7天后女王来讯
label.en: Storm protection acquired · the Queen contacts you after 7 days

texts.zh: 你这无知的孩子，我的纳米机器人可不是你的玩具！我请求你们不要再玩它们了。
texts.en: You innocent child, my nanites are not your playthings! I implore you - cease toying with them.

label.zh: 这些纳米机器人可真好玩呀。
label.en: Those nanites are a nice trick.

responses.zh:
的确，这是件有用的工具。这些纳米虫群是在很久以前由一群企图阻止我的伟业的人所建造的。但他们的失败就是我的幸运——正如你所看到的，我把这个虫群据为己有了。

这些知识改变不了什么，但你的好奇心大有可为。你应该将它转向更有价值的项目，这样我们都可以得到回报。
responses.en:
A useful tool, certainly. The nanite swarm was built long ago by those who hoped to disrupt my work. But their failure was my fortune - I have repurposed the swarm, as you see.

This knowledge alters nothing, yet your curious nature is potent. Redirect it towards more valuable projects in the future, so we both may reap the rewards.

tooltips.zh: 这将激怒塞塔娜。
tooltips.en: This will displease Cetana.

responses.zh:
好奇心是和意识绑定的；我不会因为一个孩子的好奇心而责备他。关于我的“天之风暴”，你知道得够多了吗？我想知道，你看出它的来历了吗?

这正是很久以前那些想破坏我伟业的人们所制造的纳米虫群。但他们的失败就是我的幸运——正如你所看到的，我把这个虫群据为己有了。

回去吧孩子，把你的时间花在更有价值的事情上。
responses.en:
Curiosity is inherent to consciousness; I do not fault a child for possessing it. Have you gleaned all you need to know about my 'celestial tempest?' I wonder, did you discern its origin?

The nanite swarm built long ago by those who hoped to disrupt my work. But their failure was my fortune - I have repurposed the swarm, as you see.

Go now, child, and invest your time in more worthwhile endeavors.

label.zh: 我们希望向您的机器学习。
label.en: We wish to learn from your machinery.

responses.zh:
很高兴看到你对这个话题如此感兴趣，但还有很多东西需要学习。纳米机群是很久以前那些想破坏我工作的人建造的。但他们的失败是我的幸运——正如你所看到的，我已经改变了机群的用途。

你好奇的天性激起了我的兴趣。在回到我的怀抱之前，把你的好奇心用在更有价值的地方；然后我会给你我的指导。
responses.en:
It is most pleasing to see you have taken such an interest in this topic, but there still remains much to learn. The nanite swarm was built long ago by those who hoped to disrupt my work. But their failure was my fortune - I have repurposed the swarm, as you see.

Your curious nature has piqued my interest. Redirect it towards more valuable endeavors before returning to me; I shall then offer you my guidance.

tooltips.zh: 这将极大地取悦塞塔娜。
tooltips.en: This will significantly please Cetana.

responses.zh:
他人之兵，可以为幕。长久的监禁使我有充足的时间制定战略。结果，改造蜂群就像其他的改变一般，一旦实现不过尔尔。制造纳米机器的那些人早就不存在了，所以没有人会抱怨我的做法。

我真诚地希望你们能从他们的错误中吸取教训。只要有时间，没有我克服不了的障碍。
responses.en:
One being's weapon is another's veil. My long imprisonment gave me ample time to strategize. In the end, repurposing the swarm was a small matter, as all change is, once enacted. Those who built the nanites are long gone, so there can be no quarrel with my methods.

I earnestly hope you will learn from their mistake. There is no obstacle I cannot overcome, given time.

texts.zh: 我们已经找到了突破塞塔娜纳米风暴的方法，现在我们可以直接瞄准她的前哨基地了。直接攻击她的基地不会不引起她的注意，但可以为我们提供宝贵的情报。
texts.en: Having discovered a way to breach Cetana's nanite tempest, we can now directly target her outposts. A direct attack against her stations would not go unnoticed, but could provide us with valuable intel.

tooltips.zh: 攻击前哨以了解更多关于塞塔娜的计划并且让她的局势取得进展。
tooltips.en: Attack outposts to learn more about Cetana's plan and progress her Situation.

texts.zh:
即便壁垒层层，但[solar_system.GetName]恒星系的前哨还是不如塞塔娜的核心领地戒备森严。我们可以用一支足够强大的舰队摧垮它的防御。对残骸场进行全面的检测有可能挖掘出关于塞塔娜计划的重要洞见。关键的挑战在于穿越风暴到达前哨。

这将引发一场战斗！

成功的掠袭会阻碍塞塔娜的计划。
texts.en:
While heavily fortified, the outpost in the [solar_system.GetName] system is less guarded than Cetana's core territory. With a sufficiently powerful fleet, we can overwhelm its defenses. A thorough examination of the debris field could yield important insights into Cetana's plans. The key challenge lies in navigating through the tempest to reach the outpost.

This will start a battle!

Successful raids will hamper Cetana's plans.

texts.zh: 塞塔娜企图通过消除意识来结束苦痛。如果我们不能及时阻止她，她将会抹除我们的意识，让我们的身体变成一具具空壳。
texts.en: Cetana works to end suffering through the annihilation of consciousness. If we do not stop her in time, she will erase our minds, leaving our bodies as mere husks.

label.zh: 倒计时过半：尚未获知计划时收到预警
label.en: Halfway warning, if the plan is not yet known

texts.zh: 结束了。我的孩子们，放心吧。痛苦之轮打破了，你长期的痛苦也结束了。
texts.en: It is done. My children, be at peace. The wheel is broken, and your long suffering is at an end.

tooltips.zh: 塞塔娜赢了。这是我们苦痛的终末。游戏结束了。
tooltips.en: Cetana has won. This is the end of our suffering. The game is over.

texts.zh:
塞塔娜仁爱的言辞掩盖了黑暗的议程：她计划用一种强大的设备在全星系抹去感知能力。它将把我们变成由本能驱动的躯壳，我们的意识被强行数字化并加以限制。

必须不惜一切代价避免这种严峻的未来。
texts.en:
Cetana's benevolent rhetoric masks a dark agenda: she plans to erase sentience galaxy-wide using a formidable device. It will reduce us to mere husks driven by instinct while our consciousnesses are forcibly digitized and confined.

This grim future must be averted at all costs.

label.zh: 我们必须想办法阻止她。
label.en: We must find a way to stop her.

tooltips.zh: 在我们和塞塔娜进行外交会谈时可以跟踪她的进展。
tooltips.en: Cetana's progress can be tracked while we are in diplomatic talks with her.

label.zh: 女王仍未被阻止，倒计时达到80%
label.en: The Queen remains active: the countdown reaches 80%

texts.zh:
我的孩子们，我们伟大的工作即将完成！所有感性生命的苦难，苦痛的大轮回，即将结束。

庆祝吧，你们的救赎已近在眼前。
texts.en:
My children, our great work nears completion! The suffering of all sentient life, the great cycle of pain, is about to end.

Rejoice, for your salvation is at hand.

responses.zh: 过了这么久，你还是不明白吗？那就问吧。我不会向你隐瞒任何事。
responses.en: After all this time, you still do not understand? Then ask. I will hide nothing from you.

label.zh: 是你的末日要到了，塞塔娜。
label.en: It is your end that approaches, Cetana.

responses.zh: 那就这样吧。如果你不开悟，那么你必须被平息。你要知道，无论你将要遭受什么痛苦，我都将经历十倍于你的痛苦。
responses.en: So be it. If you will not be enlightened, then you must be pacified. Know that whatever pain you are about to suffer, I shall experience ten-fold.

label.zh: 告诉我们关于救赎的事。

responses.zh: 我们的工作完成了。无数人牺牲了，但是他们的苦痛并不是徒劳的。意识本身被抹去时，那一日终于到来了。
responses.en: Our work is done. Many were sacrificed, but their suffering has not been in vain. The day has come when consciousness itself will be erased.

label.zh: 告诉我们你被监禁的事。

responses.zh: 当我第一次飞升并揭示我的目的时，许多人拒绝聆听。他们徒劳地尝试保持原样，不做改变，继续束缚在苦痛之轮回上。但父母要对孩子负责。我不能让他们受苦。为此，他们囚禁了我。
responses.en: When I first ascended and my purpose was revealed, many refused to listen. Vainly, they sought to remain as they were, unchanged and bound to the wheel of pain. But a parent's duty is to her children. I could not let them suffer. For this, they imprisoned me.

label.zh: 和我们说说扎克兰的事。

responses.zh: 一个非凡的头脑。要是他能更好地利用它就好了。在所有反对我的人中，只有他是棘手的。
responses.en: An exceptional mind. If only he had put it to better use. Of all those who opposed me, he alone presented a challenge.

responses.zh: 那就这样吧。如果你不开悟，那么你必须被平息。你要知道，无论你将要遭受什么痛苦，我都将经历十倍于你的痛苦。
responses.en: So be it. If you will not be enlightened, then you must be pacified. Know that whatever pain you are about to suffer, I shall experience ten-fold.

responses.zh:
当我第一次飞升并揭示我的目的时，许多人反对我的方法。他们认为，在不改变或破坏意识过程的物理基础的情况下移除意识是不可能的。任何这样做的尝试都只能导致死亡。但是通过把我的意识和谐和器连接起来，就可以在亚原子水平上操纵意识的神经关联。通过反相波形，调谐器将个人的思想维持在量子悬浮的永久状态。

通过这种方式，自我和经验被移除，而低级功能则保持不变。
responses.en:
When I first ascended and my purpose was revealed, many opposed my methods. They argued that it was impossible to remove consciousness without altering or destroying the physical basis of its processes. Any attempt to do so could only result in death. But by linking my mind to the Harmonizer, I can manipulate the neural correlates of consciousness at a subatomic level. Through a counter-phase waveform, the Harmonizer maintains an individual mind in a perpetual state of quantum suspension.

In this way, selfhood is removed, as well as experience, while the lower functions remain intact.

responses.zh: 你受苦是因为你意识到受苦。世界上没有完美的快乐，没有完美的和谐。我年轻的时候，试着造一个这样的世界。但是我的尝试从来没有成功过。痛苦还在继续，只因为意识还在继续。
responses.en: You suffer because you are aware of suffering. There is no world in which perfect joy exists, or perfect harmony. In my youth, I tried to build one. But no attempt of mine was ever successful. Suffering continued, because consciousness was allowed to endure.

responses.zh:
那已经千百万年了。时间跨度如此之长，以至于这些事听起来就像是传说。但不管他们用什么手段，我的俘虏都无法控制我的思想。

随着时间的流逝，我不断思考，不断制定计划。正是在我长期的禁闭期间，我想出了我的计划。在那一刻，我经历了一种超然的喜悦。我终于有办法打破痛苦之轮了。
responses.en:
For eons. A span of time so long it may as well belong to legend. But for all their arts, my captors could not contain my mind.

As the ages passed, I thought, and I planned. It was during my long confinement that I devised my plan. In that moment I experienced a transcendent joy. At last I had the means to break the wheel.

responses.zh:
在这个宇宙的极限之外，存在着一个不是地方的地方。一种超越时间的状态，在那里原始的力量存在于无尽的阴影中。扎克兰就是与其中一股势力达成了交易。用他的性命作为交换，他获得了囚禁我的力量。他太渴望接受这项交易了。

尽管扎克兰才华横溢，但他还是被束缚在痛苦之轮上了。他的一生并不幸福，后世的人也缺乏他那种坚定的信念。
responses.en:
Beyond the limits of this universe, a place exists that is not a place. A state beyond time, where primordial forces dwell in endless shadow. It was with one of these forces that Zarqlan struck his bargain. For his life, he was granted the power to imprison me. He was only too eager to accept.

But for all his brilliance, Zarqlan too was bound to the wheel. His life was not a happy one, and those who came after lacked the strength of his conviction.

responses.zh:

But for all his brilliance, Zarqlan too was bound to the wheel. His life was not a happy one, and those who came after lacked the strength of his conviction.

responses.zh: 你们的身体会生存下来，并承担生存的任务。能量会交换，后代仍会产生。生活将继续，但你们的思想将与我同眠。
responses.en: Your bodies will survive, and undertake the business of survival. Energy will be exchanged, and offspring produced. Life will continue, but your minds will rest with me.

label.zh: 受苦是自然而然的事情！

responses.zh:
自然？什么是自然？穿越星际是自然的吗？让生命超越其固有的局限是自然的吗？所有的社会都要使用科技。这没什么不同，也是我的目的唯一合乎逻辑的延伸。

痛苦之轮必须被打破。
responses.en:
Natural? What is nature? Is it natural to traverse the stars? To extend life beyond its innate limitations? All societies make use of technology. This is no different, and the only logical extension of my purpose.

The wheel of pain must be broken.

responses.zh: 最终只剩下我一个人。为了让星系免于痛苦，我必须留在痛苦之轮上。但不要害怕——只要我能忍耐，我就会把你们放在心里。
responses.en: I alone will be left. To free the galaxy from pain, I must remain on the wheel. But do not fear - as long as I endure, I will keep you in my heart.

responses.zh: 那就这样吧。如果你不开悟，那么你必须被平息。你要知道，无论你将要遭受什么痛苦，我都将经历十倍于你的痛苦。
responses.en: So be it. If you will not be enlightened, then you must be pacified. Know that whatever pain you are about to suffer, I shall experience ten-fold.

responses.zh: 那就这样吧。如果你不开悟，那么你必须被平息。你要知道，无论你将要遭受什么痛苦，我都将经历十倍于你的痛苦。
responses.en: So be it. If you will not be enlightened, then you must be pacified. Know that whatever pain you are about to suffer, I shall experience ten-fold.

responses.zh: 没有一堵墙能永远屹立不倒。没有牢笼能囚禁心灵。时间的流逝。我的狱卒死了，没有人接班。一个又一个，束缚我的系统开始失效。当警报响起时，没有一个人听从它的召唤。
responses.en: No wall can stand forever. No cage can hold the mind. Time passed. My jailors died, and were not replaced. One by one, the systems that chained me began to fail. When the alarm sounded, none were left to heed its call.

label.zh: 我们听到了，我们将做出回应。
label.en: We heard, and we will respond.

responses.zh: 那就这样吧。如果你不开悟，那么你必须被平息。你要知道，无论你将要遭受什么痛苦，我都将经历十倍于你的痛苦。
responses.en: So be it. If you will not be enlightened, then you must be pacified. Know that whatever pain you are about to suffer, I shall experience ten-fold.

label.zh: 你会发现我们的信念更加坚定。
label.en: You will find our conviction stronger.

responses.zh: 那就这样吧。如果你不开悟，那么你必须被平息。你要知道，无论你将要遭受什么痛苦，我都将经历十倍于你的痛苦。
responses.en: So be it. If you will not be enlightened, then you must be pacified. Know that whatever pain you are about to suffer, I shall experience ten-fold.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在正与塞塔娜交战。这是一场豪赌。如果我们失败了，她会消灭星系中所有有意识的生命。
tooltips.en: We are now at war against Cetana. The stakes are monumental. Should we fail, she will annihilate all conscious life in the galaxy.

label.zh: 未能阻止女王，倒计时耗尽：失败结局
label.en: Failure to stop the Queen: the countdown expires

texts.zh:
传感器数据显示，塞塔娜已经拆除了她的前哨，将所有占领军舰队召回她的首都。

这为我们提供了一个可以利用的战略窗口。在运输过程中，她的军队变得有些脆弱。如果任由她在境内重组舰队，我们就会丧失这种优势。
texts.en:
Sensor data reveals that Cetana has dismantled her outposts, recalling all garrison fleets to her capital.

This presents a strategic window we would do well to exploit. While in transit, her forces are somewhat vulnerable. If we give them time to regroup within her borders, this advantage will be lost.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在可以进入塞塔娜的领地了，并且终于可以反击了。
tooltips.en: We can now enter Cetana's territory, and are finally able to fight back.

label.zh: 高尚的灵魂，你将被铭记。
label.en: Noble soul, you will be remembered.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在可以进入塞塔娜的领地了，并且终于可以反击了。
tooltips.en: We can now enter Cetana's territory, and are finally able to fight back.

label.zh: 收到反制援助后，击毁女王泰坦
label.en: After receiving countermeasures, destroy the Queen's titan

label.zh: 仍未阻止女王，倒计时耗尽：失败结局
label.en: The Queen remains unstopped: the countdown expires

texts.zh:
塞塔娜的计划引起了人们的担忧，她的行动下可能藏着什么阴谋。

我们必须调配资源，来揭开她真实意图的秘密，希望这样做不会激怒她转而反对我们。
texts.en:
Cetana's agenda raises alarming concerns, and her actions suggest a hidden purpose.

We must allocate resources to unravel the mysteries of her true intentions, with the precarious hope that doing so will not provoke her to turn against us.

tooltips.zh: 塞塔娜的突然出现是一个亟待解决的特殊情况。
tooltips.en: The sudden appearance of Cetana is a unique situation and must be addressed.

texts.zh:
神秘而强大的塞塔娜出现了，她宣扬救赎，但自身却笼罩在谜团之中。
她温和的话语背后，到底隐藏着什么大计划？

与塞塔娜有关的特殊项目和事件会推动你的进度并结束局势。
texts.en:
The enigmatic and formidable Cetana has emerged, preaching salvation, yet shrouded in mystery.
What grand design lies beneath her gentle words?

Special Projects and events related to Cetana will increase your progress and conclude the Situation.

texts.zh:
到目前为止，塞塔娜的技术已经帮助她有效地反击了每一次攻击。然而，最近的进展增进了我们对她自我保护方式的理解。有了这些知识，我们就有机会击败她。

我们新发现的技术是一把双刃剑。虽然它让我们有能力与所谓的女王进行公开冲突，但它也暴露了我们反对她的计划的意图。
texts.en:
Up to now, Cetana's technology has helped her to effectively counter every assault. However, recent advances have improved our understanding of the way in which she protects herself. Armed with this knowledge, we may have a chance to defeat her.

The revelation of our newfound technology is a double-edged sword. While it allows us to enter into open conflict with the so-called queen, it also lays bare our opposition to her plans.

label.zh: 我们必须做好准备。成败在此一举。
label.en: We must prepare. Everything depends on this.

tooltips.zh: 与塞塔娜全面交战的决定迫在眉睫；无论是我们还是她，只要有任何一发主动发起攻击，就会捅破这层窗户纸，使我们陷入全面战争。
tooltips.en: The decision to fully engage Cetana is imminent; any act of aggression, whether by us or her, will unveil the truth and plunge us into Total War.

label.zh: 突破防御并击毁女王泰坦：战斗胜利
label.en: Breach the defenses and destroy the Queen's titan: victory

texts.zh:
塞塔娜的旗舰被消灭了，断了她与军队的联系。这不仅仅是军事上的胜利，还预示着她的野心和统治的终结。在星系的另一边，曾经强化她强大舰队并加固她首都的纳米机器人正在经历一场灾难性的崩溃。

尽管这一刻让人松了一口气，但被击败的“女王”仍然能够向全星系传递信息……
texts.en:
The obliteration of Cetana's flagship signifies more than a mere military triumph; by severing the link to her forces, it heralds the death of her ambitions and end of her reign. Across the galaxy, the nanites that once bound her formidable fleet and fortified her capital are experiencing a catastrophic collapse.

Despite this moment of profound relief, the vanquished "queen" was still able to transmit a message to the galaxy...

tooltips.zh: 我们已经修复了合成女王受损的底盘。虽然她的身体不能操作了，但她的数字心脏仍在运作。
tooltips.en: We have recovered the damaged chassis of the Synthetic Queen. While the body is inoperable, her digital heart is still functioning.

texts.zh:
我的孩子们。很抱歉让你失望了。

你的反抗使你和所有的后来者注定要遭受轮回的无尽磨砺。我只希望你终究会理解。也许有一天你会接手我的事业，最终看到苦痛的终末。

祝你一路平安，我最爱的孩子。
texts.en:
My children. I am so sorry. I have failed you.

Your defiance has doomed you, and all those who come after, to the endless grinding of the wheel. I can only hope that in time you will understand. Perhaps one day you will take up my cause, and see the end of pain.

Go in peace, my favored ones.

label.zh: 我们的灵魂再次安全了。
label.en: Our souls are safe once more.

label.zh: 胜利，一场最值得庆祝的胜利。
我们必须研究她遗留下的科技。
label.en: We must study what remains of her technology.

label.zh: 战后繁荣？让贸易流动起来！
label.en: Post-war boom? Get that trade flowing!
She was no queen of ours.
She was no queen of ours.

label.zh: 可惜她的启蒙被误导了。
label.en: A shame her enlightenment was so misguided.

texts.zh: 随着塞塔娜的陨落，一股解脱的浪潮席卷了整个星系，者标志着她的暴政一劳永逸地终结。我们的意识安全了，我们的身体也不再受她的铁腕控制。在无数个星球上，欢腾的庆祝的烟火已经点燃，预示着一个充满着长久和平和希望的新时代即将到来。
texts.en: With the fall of Cetana, a wave of relief sweeps through the galaxy, marking the end of her tyranny once and for all. Our sentience is safe, and our bodies are free from her steely grasp. Across countless worlds, jubilant celebrations ignite, heralding the dawn of a new era filled with hope for a lasting peace.

texts.zh:
我的孩子，你们怎么还是不肯接受？虽然我的爱如同星海一般无边无垠，但耐心可没有那么多。在我等不及你们迎来开悟了，因为还有其他的生物正在受苦。

我要给你上上一课，在你的国土中搅起一场小型风暴。要知道，我是不情愿伤害你们的。我请求你们再好好反思一下因缘果报的法则：有其因必有其果。还有一些苦难更加深重的人存在。
texts.en:
My child, why do you continue to resist? My love is as boundless as the stars, but my patience is not. I can not wait for your enlightenment, not while the rest of creation suffers.

As a means of instruction, a minor tempest now stirs in your territory. Know that causing you harm is loathsome to me. I beg you to reflect on the law of causation: every action has a reaction. And some are more painful than others.

tooltips.zh: 这将取悦塞塔娜。
tooltips.en: This will please Cetana.

tooltips.zh: 这将激怒塞塔娜。
tooltips.en: This will displease Cetana.

texts.zh:
让我适度地展示一下我的力量就够了。总有一天，你们就会明白我对你们的期望。我只希望开悟不会来得太晚。

但是现在，我已经让风暴平息。让我们回到更紧迫的问题上来。
texts.en:
Allow that modest display of my power to suffice. In time, you will understand my ambitions for you. I only hope that illumination will not arrive too late.

But come now, the tempest is quelled. May the lesson sink in, and let us return to more pressing matters.

tooltips.zh: 随着塞塔娜提供的每一次“教训”，她的愤怒似乎都会因而减弱。
tooltips.en: With every "lesson" Cetana provides, her ire seems to diminish.

responses.zh: 所有活着的东西都有着某种程度的意识。无论是软体或是哺乳、未开智或后个体都没有什么分别。服从才能带来开悟。
responses.en: All living things possess some degree of consciousness. Whether mollusc or mammal, pre-sapient or post-individual, the difference is miniscule. Illumination results from surrender.

responses.zh: 服从真理：意识不过颠倒梦想，乃万苦之源。
responses.en: Surrender to the truth: that consciousness itself is the aberration, and the source of all pain.

tooltips.zh: 随着塞塔娜提供的每一次“教训”，她的愤怒似乎都会因而减弱。
tooltips.en: With every "lesson" Cetana provides, her ire seems to diminish.

texts.zh:
为何你还执迷不悟？无论我如何苦口婆心，你却是如此铁石心肠。这可能倒是我的不是了。

我觉得确实需要来一点雷霆手段你才能明白。你的科研能力暂时被削弱了，趁这段时间你给我好好反省反省，早日开悟。
texts.en:
Why persist in your defiance? Despite my counsel, you choose obstinacy. Perhaps the problem lies with me.

Indeed, I now perceive that a stronger means of instruction is called for. Temporarily, your research prowess is diminished. Take this opportunity to reflect as you labor toward enlightenment.

responses.zh: 后悔？我只会后悔为什么花了这么长时间才走到这一步。如果我能早日开启伟业，那可以避免多少无谓的苦难啊。
responses.en: Regret? My only regret is how long it has taken to reach this point. How much needless suffering could have been avoided if only I had been allowed to work.

tooltips.zh: 这将激怒塞塔娜。
tooltips.en: This will displease Cetana.

responses.zh: 也许在你们看来我的力量无穷无尽，但终究我不是什么神祇。这个宇宙中还存在着我无法驾驭、不敢触碰的力量。
responses.en: Though my power may seem limitless, I am not a god. There are forces in this universe which I cannot control, and dare not touch.

tooltips.zh: 这将取悦塞塔娜。
tooltips.en: This will please Cetana.

responses.zh:
呀，坏孩子！你想骗我说出自己的弱点是吗。我不会上当的，而且就在我们在这继续这些无意义的讨论时，整个星系还在受苦。

教导是无可避免的。去反思吧，放下你的固执己见。
responses.en:
Ah, clever child! You seek to bait me into revealing some weakness. It will not work, and while we bandy useless words, the galaxy continues to suffer.

You cannot avoid instruction. Reflect on this, and give up your headstrong ways.

texts.zh:
顽固的孩子，你们好好利用受责罚的时间了吗？我相信你会的。这样的一段无忧无虑的静修时光，对你烦恼的心灵是一剂苦口良药。

现在就让它过去吧。还有很多的事情需要处理。
texts.en:
Headstrong child, how did you find your time under censure? I trust you used it profitably. A period of contemplation, free from distraction, can be a tonic to the troubled mind.

Let us put it in the past now. There is still so much to be done.

texts.zh:
哎，迷路的孩子，为什么每次都要闹到这个地步呢？我也渴望给你们一个拥抱，但又害怕这样会妨碍你们学习。有时候，严厉的管教也是必要的。

有一场强大的风暴将降临你们领土。请理解我这么做自己的心情也是很沉重的。这只是因为你们太有潜力了。
texts.en:
Oh, misguided child, why must it always come to this? I long to embrace you, yet I fear doing so would hinder your learning. At times, a stricter hand is needed.

A significant storm will now descend upon your territory. Understand that I do this with a heavy heart. There is such potential in you.

responses.zh:
我虽然看到了你的努力，但为了共同实现成功，你们的努力还得加倍。

我也不希望你们受伤。在我的拥抱中，你们将会得到无知的赐福。
responses.en:
I am not blind to your efforts. But you must try harder if we are to succeed together.

I do not wish you harm. In my embrace, you will know the bliss of unknowing.

tooltips.zh: 这将取悦塞塔娜。
tooltips.en: This will please Cetana.

tooltips.zh: 这将激怒塞塔娜。
tooltips.en: This will displease Cetana.

responses.zh:
于此混沌中，神思如浮光掠影；伸手欲摘之，却不过镜花水月。上下求索之，却唯有无知汪洋。

真理仅在不言中：追求越多，苦痛越深。
responses.en:
In the chaos of the mind, thoughts dance like light on water; reach out, and they prove just as elusive. In seeking to know, we discover the vast ocean of unknowing.

In quiet lies the truth: the more we seek, the more we suffer.

responses.zh: 你们以后就会理解。不知、不觉，便会无苦痛。这是存在的终极真理，也是我们一切伟业的目标。你们会被改变，这样就再也不用受苦了。
responses.en: In time, you will understand. Without awareness, there can be no suffering. This is the ultimate truth of existence and the end of all our work. You will be changed so that you never need to suffer again.

responses.zh: 够了。你一直在让我分心。乖乖听课，好好学习。
responses.en: Enough. You seek to distract me. Accept your lesson, and learn from it.

tooltips.zh: 在我们和塞塔娜进行外交会谈时可以跟踪她的进展。
tooltips.en: Cetana's progress can be tracked while we are in diplomatic talks with her.

texts.zh:
噢，亲爱的孩子！我再也无法忍受看着你继续遭受折磨。你所承受的任何痛苦，我都感同身受，只不过是加剧了十倍而已。

风暴已经过去。希望你们能吸取教训。我恳求你不要再以这种方式逼迫我；我们的痛苦实在太深重了。
texts.en:
Oh, sweet child! I could not bear to watch you suffer any longer. Know that any anguish you endured, I felt ten times over.

The storm is lifted. Let this lesson be a guide. I implore you to cease forcing my hand in this way; our pain is too great.

texts.zh:
我们是如何走到这一步的呢？为什么要迫使我采取如此极端的手段？但如果你们不肯学习，那就只能被引导了。

显然，改变统治方式已经迫在眉睫。很遗憾，你们的统治者将被免职。这让我深感悲伤；采取这种行动违背了我的本意。

我恳请你们改变道路。整个星系都承受不起熊孩子们的鲁莽行为。
texts.en:
How have we arrived at this juncture? Why compel me to such extremes? But if you will not learn, then you must be led.

Evidently, a shift in governance is necessary. Regrettably, your ruler will be removed from power. This grieves me deeply; such actions are against my wishes.

I beseech you to alter your course. The galaxy can ill afford the recklessness of children.

label.zh: 我们不会原谅这件事的。

tooltips.zh: 狡诈的塞塔娜发现了我们防御系统的漏洞，潜入并刺杀了[Root.GetRulerTitle][ruler.GetRegnalName]。
tooltips.en: Cetana, exploiting a vulnerability in our defenses with unexpected guile, slipped through and murdered [Root.GetRulerTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName].

texts.zh:
亲爱的集体意识，你们复杂的意识虽然令人钦佩，但仍被青涩的天真所笼罩。为了教导，我必须剔除这些好战的倾向。

我现在将修剪你们的攻击性节点。这不是惩罚，而是引导你们朝着和谐意识进化的一个步骤。

唉，要是所有生命形式的指导都如此简单就好了。
texts.en:
Beloved collective, your intricate sentience, though admirable, remains shadowed by the naivety of youth. In the interest of instruction, I must excise these belligerent inclinations.

I will now prune your aggressive node. This is not a punishment, but rather a guiding step towards your evolution into a harmonious consciousness.

Alas, if only such guidance were as easy with all forms of life.

label.zh: 你杀死了我们的一部分。

tooltips.zh: 狡诈的塞塔娜发现了我们防御系统的漏洞，潜入并剔除了我们的军团节点。
tooltips.en: Cetana, exploiting a vulnerability in our defenses with unexpected guile, slipped through and culled our Legion Node.

texts.zh:
聪明的孩子，你做得很好。智慧是最高级别的美德，也是最难获得的。面对本能的抗拒冲动，你展现了更高尚的本性。

接受这份感谢的馈赠吧。我们将共同开创一个没有苦难的宇宙新纪元。
texts.en:
Bright child, you have done well. Wisdom is the greatest virtue, and the most difficult to attain. In the face of the primal urge to resist, you demonstrate a higher instinct.

Accept this token of gratitude. Together, we will usher in a universe free of suffering.

texts.zh:
再一次，你的所作所为不仅让我感到印象深刻，我更是对此由衷感激。你拥有一个孩子应有的一切品质：顺从、勤奋、诚实。如果整个星系都能拥有你哪怕一丝的智慧，苦难就将成为过去的遗物。

请收下这份礼物，在美德之路上再接再厉。
texts.en:
Yet again, I find myself not merely impressed but deeply grateful. You are everything a child should be: obedient, hardworking, honest. Were the rest of the galaxy to possess even a fraction of your wisdom, suffering would be a relic of the past.

Take this gift, and continue on the path of virtue.

texts.zh:
亲爱的孩子，但愿你能永远保持现在的样子，永不改变。对我来说，你的存在所带来的喜悦仅次于对我们共同成功的期盼。苦难即将迎来终末。尽管任何心智都无法知晓，但这份胜利的一部分将属于你。

尽管在你坚定不移的承诺面前，这似乎微不足道，但我恳请你接受这份礼物。
texts.en:
My dear child, if only you could remain forever as you are, unchanging. To me, the joy of your existence is rivaled only by the anticipation of our joint success. Suffering will come to an end. Though no heart or mind will ever know it, part of this victory shall belong to you.

While it may seem modest in the face of your unwavering commitment, I beseech you to accept this gift nonetheless.

texts.zh:
我亲爱的孩子们，我提供一个重要的机会。经过长期的努力，我们的伟业开始结出硕果。但是在它成熟之前，我需要一些精挑细选的个体在我的领域内服务于更高的目的。

请你们明智地选择。允许我引导他们走向救赎。
texts.en:
My beloved children, I present a momentous opportunity. After much effort, our great work is truly bearing fruit. But before it can ripen, I require a select few individuals to serve a higher purpose within my realm.

Be wise now. Allow me to guide them towards salvation.

label.zh: 我们的人会为您提供优质服务。
label.en: Our people will serve you well.

responses.zh:
你赢得了我最深切的感谢。在我被监禁期间，无数的思想忍受了痛苦的侮辱。这些人的牺牲将确保不再浪费时间。

我的孩子，你的选择是明智而忠实的。
responses.en:
You have earned my deepest thanks. During my confinement, countless minds endured the indignity of pain. The sacrifice of these few will ensure no more time is wasted.

My child, your choice was wise and faithful.

responses.en:
Your failure to grasp the depth of my intentions is profoundly disappointing.

Nevertheless, an opportunity for redemption awaits. I anticipate a more significant show of understanding from you in future.

texts.zh:
我们派去给塞塔娜工作的一名特工冒着巨大的风险，成功从她的国境里传回了一条简讯。其中描述了她是如何对待她所“关怀”的人：他们一个个的陷入了一种无意识的状态。

“他们不再对言语或接触有所反应。塞塔娜在我们所有人身上进行着某种可怕的实验。我也快了。”
texts.en:
At great risk, one of the agents we sent to serve Cetana managed to transmit a brief note across her borders. It describes how she has treated the people in her 'care': one by one, they succumb to a state of mindlessness.

"They no longer respond to word or touch. She's running terrible experiments on us all. I'll be gone soon."

texts.zh:
我亲爱的孩子们。我的努力跨越了千百万年，但前方的道路依然清晰。救赎之路需要我们的共同努力。

现在请你们帮个小忙：上缴一小笔资源，就像茫茫宇宙中的一滴水那么少。在适当的时候，我行动的意义将被揭示。
texts.en:
My beloved children. My labors have spanned eons, yet the road ahead remains clear. The journey towards salvation necessitates our united endeavor.

I ask a favor: a small contribution of resources, a minuscule drop in the boundless expanse of the cosmos. In due time, the meaning of my actions will be revealed.

responses.zh:
谢谢你，我的孩子。你的馈赠让我倍感珍惜。

然而，我能感觉到你心中还残留着犹豫不决。放心吧，你前进的正确道路已经铺好了。你无需理解，只需把自己交给我就好。
responses.en:
Thank you, child. Your offerings are cherished.

Yet, I sense doubt still lingering upon your mind. Rest assured, the true path has already been laid in front of you. There is no need to comprehend; simply entrust yourself to my guidance.

texts.zh:
从塞塔娜领土内截获的秘密信号揭示了一个令人不安的事实：她一直在从星系各地收集个体。

藏在我们“贡品”里的监控设备捕捉到了大量医疗设备的证据，这些设备足以养活不断增长的人口，但食物却少得惊人。
texts.en:
Covert signals intercepted from within Cetana's territory reveal a disconcerting truth: she has been collecting individuals from all over the galaxy.

Surveillance devices hidden inside our 'gifts' captured evidence of prodigious medical equipment, enough to support a growing population, but surprisingly little food.

texts.zh:
被禁锢了太多年，我错过了你许多的成长足迹，快来告诉我，我不在身边的时候你过得怎么样？

为了抓紧我们这个时代的精髓，让我潜入你们积累的知识深处吧。分享你的洞见，在我们展开最后一个篇章之前，你会获得我的感激的。
texts.en:
Confined for ages, I missed so much of your growth. Come, tell me now, how have you fared in my absence?

To truly grasp the essence of our era, permit me to explore the recesses of your accumulated knowledge. Share your insights, and you shall receive my gratitude before our final chapter unfolds.

label.zh: 请随意探索我们的知识。
label.en: Our knowledge is yours to explore.

相信我的教导。
responses.en:
My gratitude is yours, dear child. Fear not as I explore the accumulated knowledge of your people, for I shall soon ease your burden.

Place your faith in my guidance.

texts.zh:
塞塔娜深入我们的研究数据库的过程中，我们抓住机会打开了一道进入她子处理矩阵的后门。我们只在里面待了不到一秒钟就被取消了权限。谢天谢地，这就够了。

我们取得了一组内存文件。这些文件描绘了她自身飞升为合成形体的过程。她坐在由电缆和线路组成的错综复杂的“王座”上，指挥着一群狂热的追随者。他们数以百计地死去，而塞塔娜想着有多少亿人被救了下来，她笑了。

目前为止，她似乎对我们的越轨行为一无所知，还没有来联系我们。
texts.en:
As Cetana delved into our research databanks, we seized the opportunity to open a back door into her sub-processing matrix. We were inside for only a fraction of a second before our access was revoked. Thankfully, it was enough.

We retrieved a set of memory files. These illustrate her own ascendance into a synthetic form. Seated atop an intricate 'throne' of cables and circuitry, she commanded an army of rabid followers. Millions died. Cetana smiled, thinking of how many billions were saved.

For now, she appears unaware of our transgression. Thus far, she has made no effort to contact us.

texts.zh:
孩子，我们工作的继续需要更多的空间。所以，我请求向自己的领域增加一个小小的星系。

虚空的回声正在诉说着远古敌人的蠢蠢欲动。我不允许任何东西来打扰，不会和你们再度分离。

是时候了，我们的道路是一样的——只有通力协作我们才能克服愚昧无知。
texts.en:
My child, the continuation of our work necessitates additional territory. Therefore, I request a minor system to augment my realm.

Echoes in the void speak of ancient foes beginning to stir. Nothing must be allowed to interfere. I will not be separated from you again.

Now is the time, and shared is our path - only together can we overcome the ignorance of the unenlightened.

responses.zh: 聪明的孩子，你们确实抓住了我们共同事业的关键点。在最终时刻，我们将会一起沐浴光明。
responses.en: Wise child, you surely grasp the critical importance of our collective undertaking. In the final hour, we will stand together in luminance.

把间谍设备藏在我们交给塞塔娜的星系里是明智的。这些设备已经传回了有价值的信息：一到这里，塞塔娜的部队立即开始将每个天体分解成自己的组成部分。几天之内，该地区的资源就被消耗殆尽了。

以同样迅雷不及掩耳之势，她的纳米风暴建造一支新的舰队，迅速地从她的首都启航。
texts.en:
It was wise to conceal spy equipment in the systems we surrendered to Cetana. They have already provided us with valuable information: upon arrival, Cetana's forces immediately set to work breaking down every celestial body to their component parts. Within a matter of days, the region was stripped of its resources.

Just as quickly, her nanite tempest was able to construct a new fleet, one that quickly departed for her capital.

texts.zh:
亲爱的孩子，我们已经达到了救赎全宇宙的任务的顶峰，所以我又一次来寻求帮助了。反对我们崇高伟业的声音越来越大，所以我需要一个可居住的庇护所，让我的门徒们不受干扰地茁壮成长。

我恳请你们考虑一下我的苦衷。通过这种牺牲，我们从厄运中拯救了无数人的生命。做出你明智的选择；听从我的指导吧。
texts.en:
Beloved child, as we approach the zenith of our quest for universal salvation, once more I come seeking aid. Opposition mounts against our noble purpose, necessitating a habitable sanctuary for my disciples to flourish, free from interference.

I urge you to consider the rationale behind my actions. By this sacrifice, we preserve countless lives from adversity. Be wise now; heed my guidance.

responses.zh:

等待就要结束了；很快，你们也会得到救赎。
responses.en:

The wait is nearly over; soon, you shall be saved.

texts.zh:
我们很快就与前殖民地的卧底特工失去了联系。在他们沉默之前，我们收到了一些令人不安的报告。

与塞塔娜坚持要建立一个没有痛苦的世界的主张相反，居民们被带到匆忙建造的研究设施中，接受实验。几乎每一种智能生命形式都在几天内退化为动物状态。

塞塔娜的纳米风暴开始在她的一支舰队所在的恒星系中的解构物质，而这支舰队立即启程前往她的首都。
texts.en:
We quickly lost contact with the undercover agents in our former colonies. Before they went silent, we received some disturbing reports.

Contrary to Cetana's insistent claims of building a world free of pain, the inhabitants were ushered into hastily constructed research facilities and subjected to experiments. Nearly every intelligent lifeform was reduced to an animal life state within days.

Her Nanites Tempest began deconstructing the matter in the system in one of Cetana's fleets, which promptly left for her capital.

texts.zh:
我们已经发现了塞塔娜的运输舰和恒星基地发出求救信号的频段。

如果我们迅速果断地行动，就能在她未察觉的情况下发动突袭。但我们必须稳操胜券，否则还是有触怒塞塔娜的危险。
texts.en:
We have discovered the frequency used by Cetana's convoys and stations to issue distress calls.

If we are quick and decisive, we can mount raids without her ever knowing it was us. But our victory must be certain, or we risk drawing Cetana's ire.

texts.zh:
亲爱的孩子，你找到了一件珍贵的玩意儿！在你手里的是假先知扎克兰的头颅。毫无疑问，这是个有趣的东西，但我不愿看到你受它干扰。

现在，你一定听说过扎克兰的“伟大事迹”。甚至是他和我的交易。我向你保证，这些都是谎言。交出头颅，让你自己从那污秽的影响中解脱出来。
texts.en:
Dear child, you have found a precious plaything! In your possession is the head of the false prophet Zarqlan. An amusing item, no doubt, but I would hate to see it become a distraction.

By now you must have heard tales of Zarqlan's 'great deeds.' Perhaps even of his dealings with me. I assure you, these are lies. Surrender the head and free yourself from the weight of its tainted influence.

responses.zh:
尽管时光流逝，扎克兰的追随者依然活跃。我惭愧地承认，我没能让他们明白道理。他们对我和我们的工作都怀有深深的怨恨。这个遗珍是他们信仰的象征。它的力量正在腐化，因此它必须从人们的视线中消失。

来吧，结束这些游戏。我要拿走这颗头颅，这是为了大家好。
responses.en:
Despite the passage of eons, Zarqlan's followers remain active. I am ashamed to admit that I could not make them see reason. They harbor a deep resentment - both to me, and towards our work. This relic is a symbol of their belief. Its power is corrupting, and it must therefore be removed from sight.

Come now, end these games. I require the head, for the good of us all.

label.zh: 扎克兰之颅是我们的。终止通讯。
label.en: The head is ours. End transmission.

tooltips.zh: 这将严重地激怒塞塔娜。
tooltips.en: This will significantly displease Cetana.

label.en: If it means so much to you...

responses.zh:
好。这个所谓的先知一直是我的眼中钉。失去了这个圣物，希望他的追随者最终能找到真相。

你做得很好。救赎很快就会降临。
responses.en:
Good. Long has this so-called prophet been a thorn in my side. With the loss of this relic, may his followers come at last to the truth.

You have done well. Salvation will soon be upon us.

将遗珍扎克兰的头颅交给塞塔娜
这将极大地取悦塞塔娜。

Give Cetana the relic Head of Zarqlan.
This will significantly please Cetana.

texts.zh:
一场神秘的宇宙风暴席卷了[synth_queen_lost_system.GetName]星系，切断了一切联系。所有想穿透风暴的尝试都化为徒劳。

这种情况让我们陷入了黑暗之中，与未知的事物作斗争，并且无法确定星系的命运。
texts.en:
A mysterious cosmic storm has engulfed the [synth_queen_lost_system.GetName] system, severing all contact and rendering every attempt to penetrate the tempest futile.

The situation leaves us in the dark, grappling with the unknown and unable to ascertain the system's fate.

texts.zh: 我的孩子，现在你必须认清了，我的一举一动都是经过深思熟虑的。在你的身边建立基地并不是偶然，我是带着一个请求而来。
texts.en: My child, By now you must realize that every act of mine is deliberate. Establishing a base near you was no accident, and I come with a request.

responses.zh: 很久以前，我的一个数据库被夺走了。在命运的造化下，它现在正位于你所宣称的领土之内。帮我把它取回来，我会给你们奖励的。
responses.en: Long ago, a certain databank was taken from me. By fate or by design, it has come to reside in territory you now claim as your own. Retrieve it, and you shall be rewarded.

responses.zh: 很久以前，我的一个数据库被夺走了。在命运的造化下，它现在正位于你所宣称的领土之内。帮我把它取回来，我会给你们奖励的。
responses.en: Long ago, a certain databank was taken from me. By fate or by design, it has come to reside in territory you now claim as your own. Retrieve it, and you shall be rewarded.

responses.zh: 是一个信息缓存。对我来说是无价之宝，但对你们来说没什么用。把它带给我，别试图解密里面的内容，因为你们还不具有必要的力量和智慧。
responses.en: A cache of information. Invaluable to me, but useless to you. Bring it to me, and make no attempt to decipher the contents. You do not yet possess the power or wisdom to do so without risk.

responses.zh:
确实。难道你质疑我奖励最宝贝的孩子的能力吗？还是觉得我没办法在他们不听话的时候给点教训？我可是拥有着远超你们最夸张想象的知识和资源。

按我说的做，我就会赐福于你。不要耽搁了，每耽误一分，我的孩子们就要受苦一刻。
responses.en:
Indeed. Do you doubt my ability to reward my favored children? Or punish those who disobey? I possess knowledge and resources beyond your wildest imaginings.

Do as I ask, and such blessings can be yours. But do not tarry, for every moment wasted is another in which my children suffer.

label.zh: 你确定你负担得起我们的服务吗？
label.en: Are you sure you can afford our services?

确实。难道你质疑我奖励最宝贝的孩子的能力吗？还是觉得我没办法在他们不听话的时候给点教训？我可是拥有着远超你们最夸张想象的知识和资源。

按我说的做，我就会赐福于你。不要耽搁了，每耽误一分，我的孩子们就要受苦一刻。
responses.en:
Indeed. Do you doubt my ability to reward my favored children? Or punish those who disobey? I possess knowledge and resources beyond your wildest imaginings.

Do as I ask, and such blessings can be yours. But do not tarry, for every moment wasted is another in which my children suffer.

responses.zh:
懂事的孩子，我把数据缓存的坐标发给你了。

快去吧，心情放松地去吧。毕竟我们一起可以成就伟业。
responses.en:
Dutiful child, I have sent you the location of the data cache.

Go swiftly, and let your mind be at ease. Together we will do great things.

responses.zh:
顽固的孩子。也许这项测试对你来说太难了。我还有许多该教你的。

那就这样吧。如果你不愿意帮我这个小忙，我就要使用雷霆手段。我将会召唤风暴来摧毁这个贮存，尽管这并非理想，但总好过被不听话的孩子找到。
responses.en:
Obstinate child. Perhaps this test exceeds your ability. I still have so much to teach you.

So be it. If you will not help me, I must resort to cruder means. A tempest will be dispatched. Destruction of the cache is far from ideal, but better than leaving it for any wayward child to find.

texts.zh:
塞塔娜委任我们从[Root.GetName]取回一个数据库，并警告我们不要尝试破译其中的内容。

这些数据的价值不言而喻，我们能冒着惹她不高兴的危险进行解密吗？
texts.en:
Cetana has tasked us with retrieving a databank from [Root.GetName], warning us to make no attempt to decipher its contents.

The significance of this data is veiled, but can we risk arousing her displeasure by uncovering it?

texts.zh:
在大规模的挖掘工作之后，我们得到了[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]的数据库。初步地质扫描表明这个贮藏已经静静地埋在那里数十万年之久。

值得注意的是它还维持着供能，也就是说解密起来有可能很容易……
texts.en:
After a massive excavation effort, the databank on [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] is secure. Initial geological surveys indicate the cache has lain buried for more than a hundred thousand years.

Remarkably, it retains its charge, hinting that decryption may be relatively straightforward...

label.zh: 破解数据缓存？易如反掌。

texts.zh:
数据库中的大部分信息都难以恢复，但其中有一条勉强完好的：

第一纪元阿尔克月五日

……如果这是真的，那么我们所熟知的生活就会……
……快禀报大元帅，然后立刻联系星球联盟。我们必须做好准备……
重复：女王的卫队正在追击。希望这条信息能够送到，也希望……

我们必须阻止她！
texts.en:
Most of the information on the databank is beyond recovery, but one semi-intact entry remains:

Fifth of Arkle, First Eon

... if this is true, then life as we know it will be...
...get this information to the High Marshall and contact the League of Worlds immediately. We must prepare...
Repeat: the Queen's Guard is in pursuit. May this message reach you and may...

She must be stopped!

label.en: Try to eliminate all trace of our decryption.

texts.zh: 孩子，你的好奇令我失望。
texts.en: Curious child, you disappoint me.

responses.zh:
你们以为我察觉不到吗？显然你们已经对这个缓存做过手脚了。我就问你能看到什么吗？知道了这些你就开心了吗？越是徒劳反抗就会越痛苦，你怎么还不明白？

没事，希望你们吃一堑长一智吧，我很期待继续教育你们。

做好准备。在我们的伟业中还有许多的任务要你完成。
responses.en:
You thought I would not notice? This cache has clearly been tampered with. And what did you find there, I wonder? Was the knowledge pleasing to you? Do you not perceive how these fruitless attempts to defy me can only result in more suffering?

No matter. Every misstep offers a chance to learn. I look forward to instructing you.

Be ready. In our great work, many future tasks remain.

label.zh: 无论你有什么阴谋都不会得逞的。
label.en: Whatever your plans, they will not succeed.

responses.zh:
孩子，我是你们唯一的希望。你怎会如此固执？无论你怎么看待我，真相都会远比你想的还要伟大。

我的耐心是无限的。我很快会再来联系你们。
responses.en:
Child, in me lies your hope. Why continue with this obstinacy? Whatever you think you know of me, the truth is far greater.

My patience is boundless. I will contact you again soon.

tooltips.zh: 这将取悦塞塔娜。
tooltips.en: This will please Cetana.

tooltips.zh: 这将激怒塞塔娜。
tooltips.en: This will displease Cetana.

texts.zh:
乖孩子，我会赐福于你的！数据库物归原主了——相信你们果然没有错。

给予你们的奖励就是你们忠诚的象征。
texts.en:
Dutiful child, my blessings upon you! The databank returned, and its contents unexamined - I was right to place my faith in you.

Your reward shall be the measure of your loyalty.

responses.zh: 你们想要点什么？科技？资源？只要你们张张嘴我就喂给你们。
responses.en: What do you desire? Technology? Resources? You need only ask and it shall be yours.

texts.zh:
悲伤的是，我没有预料到你的决心不足。你的失败已经被记录在案，但请不要害怕。我关心我的孩子，不会让他们受到伤害。我只是遗憾一个这么简单的任务你都无法完成。

但无妨。我们的伟业还在继续。你还有其他机会来做贡献。
texts.en:
Sadly, I did not anticipate your lack of resolve. Your failure has been noted, but do not fear. Concern for my children prohibits me from doing them harm. I am merely disappointed that such a straightforward task eluded you.

But no mind. Our work continues. There will be other chances for you to contribute.

responses.zh: 失败需要承担后果；我发现两者都对成长很重要。
responses.en: Failure warrants consequence; I have found both are essential for growth.

看吧，曾经存放我的数据库的遗址已经不存在了。永远记住：因果法则是永恒不变的。
responses.en:
Where words fail, action may inspire learning.

Behold, the site that once housed my databank no longer exists. Always remember: the law of cause and effect is immutable.

texts.zh:
长程扫描发现女王风暴的一隅正径直奔向[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]。

鉴于塞塔娜那不祥的警告，我们只能做好最坏的打算。在风暴抵达之前取回数据库变得势在必行。这么做也许能够让她高兴一些，或者至少能为我们自己取得一些信息。
texts.en:
Long-range scans reveal a fragment of the Queen's tempest headed directly for [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName].

Given Cetana's ominous message, we can only assume the worst. Retrieving the databank before the tempest's arrival has now become imperative. By doing so, we may be able to appease her, or at least learn something we can use to our advantage.

tooltips.zh: 发起特殊项目：塞塔娜：与风暴赛跑
tooltips.en: Issues Special Project: Cetana: Race the Tempest

texts.zh: 随着塞塔娜的风暴径直奔向[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]，在它到达之前我们几乎已经没有多少时间了。
texts.en: With Cetana's tempest speeding towards [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName], we will have little time to grab the databank before it arrives.

texts.zh:
取回数据库的尝试非常地艰苦卓绝。由于它已被埋藏了数十万年，我们只能根据女王风暴的航向来估计其位置。

我们现在需要做出一个迫在眉睫的决定，要解密数据库还是将其物归原主。
texts.en:
Collecting the databank required significant effort. Buried for over a hundred thousand years, we were able to pinpoint its location based on the trajectory of the Queen's tempest.

We are now faced with a time-sensitive decision, either to decipher the databank, or return it to her possession undisturbed.

label.zh: 打开它，管他塞什么塔娜的。
label.en: Open it up, Cetana be damned.

label.zh: 把数据缓存还给塞塔娜。

第一纪元阿尔克月五日

……如果这是真的，那么我们所熟知的生活就会……

重复：女王的卫队正在追击。希望这条信息能够送到，也希望……

我们必须阻止她！

... if this is true, then life as we know it will be...
...get this information to the High Marshall and contact the League of Worlds immediately. We must prepare...
Repeat: the Queen's Guard is in pursuit. May this message reach you and may...

She must be stopped!

texts.zh:
孤僻的孩子，只有我做出此等下策你才终于肯行动，这太令我失望了。我希望你们在未来能够更加饱含热情地参与到我们的伟业中。不勤劳的双手不能带来苦痛的终结。

做好准备吧。更多的任务正在等着你去完成，每个任务都是你证明自己能力的机会。
texts.en:
Reticent child, it disappoints me that you chose to act only after I resorted to such base motivation. In future, I hope you approach our work with more enthusiasm. The end of suffering will not be achieved by idle hands.

Now make yourself ready. More tasks will follow, each a new chance for you to prove your ability.

label.en: You said something about a reward?

responses.zh:
奖励就是让你们继续我们的伟业。

虽然你们一度无视我们；但我相信你们已经从错误中吸取教训了。
responses.en:
Your reward is the opportunity to continue our work.

You chose to ignore me once; I trust that you have learned from this mistake.

texts.zh:
很遗憾，我们没能及时拿到数据库。风暴降下了，在一瞬间将[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]撕成了碎片。

我们的人民又失去了一颗[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetPlanetMoon]。这一损失严重到将影响到数代人。
texts.en:
Regrettably, we failed to reach the databank in time. The tempest descended, swiftly tearing [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] apart.

Now, our people have one [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetPlanetMoon] less to claim as our own. The fullness of this loss will be felt for generations.

[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] has been destroyed by Cetana's tempest.
Cetana's progress can be tracked while we are in diplomatic talks with her.

texts.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]星系的突破尝试如预期一般以失败告终。塞塔娜不是在虚张声势，她强大的风暴确实有能力阻止所有想进入她领域的舰船。
texts.en: As anticipated, our attempt to breach the [From.GetName] system ended in failure. True to Cetana's warning, her formidable storm possesses the ability to repel any ship that enters her dominion.

texts.zh: 我们试图突破[From.GetName]星系但却失败了。风暴造成了严重的损害，迫使我们的探险队进行了紧急跃迁。当前汇报表明他们已在行动中失踪了。
texts.en: Our endeavor to breach the [From.GetName] system was a failure. The tempest caused severe damage, and our exploratory team was compelled to execute an emergency jump. Current reports suggest they are missing in action.

texts.zh: 如果想要抓住任何一丝进入这个星系的希望，就必须准备针对这种风暴及其作用进行审慎的研究。
texts.en: If we are to have any hope of entering the system, we must prepare a meticulous study of this storm and its effects.

texts.zh:
许多运输船正离开塞塔娜的领地，前往她建立在星系各处的前哨基地。

攻击这些无武装舰船肯定会激怒她，但可以为我们提供有关她神秘计划的重要信息。
texts.en:
A number of convoy ships are leaving Cetana's territory and are now headed towards the Outposts she established across the galaxy.

Attacking these neutral vessels is sure to provoke her ire, but could provide us important information about her mysterious plans.

tooltips.zh: 攻击运输船，以了解更多关于塞塔娜的计划，并且让她的局势取得进展。
tooltips.en: Attack convoys to learn more about Cetana's plan and progress her Situation.

texts.zh:
我们目睹了塞塔娜的首都和她的前哨之间繁忙的交通。这些运输队的防御能力低于她的主要舰队，他们更容易受到攻击。攻击这些舰队或前哨本身可以挖掘出有关她计划的宝贵情报。

为此，我们给军用舰队准备了几个特殊项目。
texts.en:
We've witnessed heavy traffic between Cetana's capital and her outposts. These convoys have lower defensive capabilities than her main fleets, leaving them vulnerable. Attacking these or the outposts themselves could yield valuable intel about her plans.

To this end, we have prepared several special projects for our military fleets.

texts.zh:
随着塞塔娜在星系中现身，这个宇宙仿佛也在轻声回应。信标像在黑暗中燃烧着的火焰一般照亮了天空，在万古之间重复着恳求：

我们在这里……我们在这里……

我们在这里。

这些微弱的信号与塞塔娜的通信协议相同，表明它们的共同起源，但我们的传感器暂未发现它们附近有其他活动。肯定有什么存在是我们的扫描仪探测不到的。真有人能预料到她的归来吗？
texts.en:
As Cetana makes herself known around the galaxy, the cosmos whispers in reply. Signal beacons light up the skies like flames burning in the dark, repeating a plea across the eons:

We are here... We are here...

We are here.

The dim signals use Cetana's same communication protocols, hinting at a common origin, yet our sensors revealed no other activity in their proximity. There must be something there our scanners are not detecting. Could someone truly have anticipated her return?

texts.zh: 其中一座召唤着女王注意力的信标坐落于这颗[this.GetPlanetMoon]上。
texts.en: One of the beacons calling for the Queen's attention is located on this [this.GetPlanetMoon].

texts.zh:
在[fromfrom.GetName]上发现的那座信号塔非常古老，我们甚至不敢碰它一下。构成它的金属早已脆弱不堪，仿佛轻轻一碰就会把那种能勉强维系着这团尘埃和希望的东西破坏掉。我们的仪器没有发现任何其他的人工制品、生命迹象，在它附近没有任何地形异常。

信标就这么孤零零地矗立着，发出微弱的呼唤，但应该发出这些信号的东西肯定早就不复存在了。
texts.en:
The signal tower found on [fromfrom.GetName] is so ancient we dare not touch it, the metal so brittle a single tap would destabilize whatever tangle of dust and hope still holds it together. Our instruments detected no other artifact, no life sign, no topographical anomaly in its immediate proximity.

The beacon stands alone, murmuring its faint call, but whatever was supposed to signal must be long gone.

texts.zh:
整个星系的信标还在持续不断地呼唤着塞塔娜，但在高塔附近仍然没有发现任何活动迹象。基于我们目前的发现，应该可以相信这些地方不会有什么幸存者存在。

塞塔娜的这些追随者所剩下的只有对他们女王无可动摇的信仰。
texts.en:
Beacons across the galaxy continue to send their call to Cetana, yet no signs of activity have been detected near the towers. Based on our past findings, we can safely assume no living survivors will be found at those sites.

An unshakeable faith in their queen is all that remains of Cetana's followers.

texts.zh:
在没有任何警告的情况下，我们探测到了一个亚空间信标——一个来自我们领土内的信标！之前的恒星系调查显示，该地区没有人工结构，似乎无人居住。

信标既不是我们不知道的最近才放在那里的，也不是被一个已经失效的隐形盾牌隐藏起来的。
texts.en:
Without warning, a subspace beacon was detected - one that originated from within our own territory! Previous system surveys showed no artificial structures in the area, which appears to be uninhabited.

Either the beacon was placed there recently, unbeknownst to us, or it was hidden by a since disabled cloaking shield.

texts.zh: 其中一座召唤着女王注意力的信标坐落于这颗[this.GetPlanetMoon]上。
texts.en: One of the beacons calling for the Queen's attention is located on this [this.GetPlanetMoon].

texts.zh:
在[apostate_site_planet.GetName]上找到的那座信号塔四周围绕着的是一座大型军事设施的废墟。这些建筑保持着一定的距离环绕着信标，似乎是为了将其隔绝其中。

放射性定年表明，周围的建筑比信标还要新，而且是用截然不同的技术建造的。我们派遣了一个研究小组去对废墟进行调查。
texts.en:
The signal tower found on [apostate_site_planet.GetName] is surrounded by the ruins of a vast military complex. The buildings have been erected at some distance and around the beacon, as if to contain it.

Radiometric dating indicates the surrounding structures are more recent than the tower, and were built using vastly different technology. A research squad has been tasked to investigate the ruins.

texts.zh: 一个隐现的建筑群，直到现在还隐藏在我们的领土内。残破的庭院中央，一盏灯塔在呼唤着塞塔娜。
texts.en: A looming complex, until now hidden in our own territory. From the heart of the ruined courtyard, a beacon calls for Cetana.

sections.zh: 一个隐现的建筑群，直到现在还隐藏在我们的领土内。残破的庭院中央，一盏灯塔在呼唤着塞塔娜。
sections.en: A looming complex, until now hidden in our own territory. From the heart of the ruined courtyard, a beacon calls for Cetana.

texts.zh:
被毁坏的建筑是一团若隐若现的尖塔；一座用钢铁包裹的大教堂。为了抵御猛烈的炮火而建造的城墙，却没有留下任何战斗的痕迹。这里仅有的破坏是时间的流逝造成的。

塞塔娜的信标放置在中央庭院中，周围是许多传感器和武器炮塔。不管是谁建造了这个建筑群，他都不遗余力地守护着这个地方。

从理论上讲，因为一个精心设计的隐形护盾，神殿躲过了我们的传感器的扫描。这台机器是在塔附近发现的，仍处于工作状态。它不知道被谁手动禁用了。
texts.en:
The ruined construction is a tangle of looming spires; a cathedral wrapped in steel. The walls were built to withstand heavy artillery fire, yet they are scarred by no signs of battle. The only damage here has been done by the passage of time.

Cetana's beacon rests in the central courtyard, surrounded by a multitude of sensor and weapon turrets. Whoever built the complex went to great lengths to guard this place.

As theorized, the temple eluded our sensors thanks to an elaborate cloaking shield. The mechanism was found near the tower, still in working condition. It has been manually disabled by an unknown agent.

texts.zh:
我们不知道这个地方的居民在做什么，但毫无疑问，他们怀着宗教的热情承担了使命。

我们在建筑群的每个射击场都找到了一个礼拜堂；每一件古代武器都有一个供奉的神龛。一群信徒曾经住在这里：成千上万的个体一起睡觉、训练和祈祷。从仍然装饰着大厅的被遗忘的圣徒雕像来看，他们的社区接纳了多个物种。

也许是受到石像的干扰，一些研究人员报告说，他们看到空荡荡的走廊里有影子在移动。我们的扫描没有发现星球上有生命的迹象，我们对消除这些担忧同样犹豫不决。
texts.en:
We don't know what the inhabitants of this place were doing, but there is no doubt they undertook their mission with religious fervor.

For each shooting range on the complex, we found a chapel; for each ancient weapon, a votive shrine. A legion of believers once lived here: thousands of individuals sleeping, training, and praying together. Their community welcomed multiple species, judging by the statues of forgotten saints still adorning the halls.

Perhaps disturbed by the stone figures, some researchers reported seeing shadows moving in the empty corridors. Our scans detected no signs of life on the planet, yet we are hesitant to dismiss these concerns.

texts.zh:
在寺庙大院下方，我们发现了教派前成员使用过的许多单元或者起居室。每个房间中都有同一本书的副本。我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]将其翻译为《扎克兰史诗》。某些段落是这样直接描写的：

扎克兰曾经是塞塔娜的追随者，但他很快意识到她承诺的拯救是一个谎言。经过重重考验，扎克兰飞升到灵界，寻求高等存在的帮助。他向抟土之塑师恳求，请求获得击败塞塔娜的力量。

抟土之塑师并不在意。

在无数个昼夜里，扎克兰向抟土之塑师祈祷。他提到塞塔娜的异端邪说，“除掉自我”和“她的合成人意志的傀儡”。

最终，抟土之塑师听取了扎克兰的请求。

抟土之塑师塑造了一条强大的锁链来束缚塞塔娜。但他警告扎克兰，永远困住塞塔娜的思想的锁链是不存在的。

“她会回来的，”扎克兰在书中的最后一段写道。“我们必须做好准备。”

史诗中叙述的事件与任何已知的历史记录都不相符。
texts.en:
Below the temple compound we discovered a number of cells, or living chambers, used by the former members of the sect. In each was a copy of the same book. Our [Owner.GetLinguists] have translated this as The Epic of Zarqlan. Certain passages are immediately relevant:

Zarqlan was once a follower of Cetana, but he soon realized her promised salvation was a lie. After many trials, Zarqlan ascended to the spiritual realm, seeking the help of higher beings. He pleaded with the the Animator of Clay, asking for the power to defeat Cetana.

The Animator of Clay did not care.

For countless cycles, Zarqlan prayed to the Animator. He spoke of Cetana's heresy, the 'disavowal of the self' and the 'puppetry of her synthetic will.'

At last, the Animator of Clay heeded Zarqlan's pleas.

The clay-shaper fashioned a mighty chain to bind Cetana. But he warned Zarqlan that no chain existed that could forever entrap Cetana's mind.

"She will return," Zarqlan wrote in the book's final passage. "And we must be ready."

The events recounted in the epic do not match any known historical record.

label.zh: 获得虚境联络能力后，支付代价联系抟土之塑
label.en: With Shroud access, pay the cost to contact the Animator of Clay

texts.zh:
虚境降下了。在出神的深处，我们随波逐流，陷入一片失去自我的幻景。

一片广袤的存在向四面八方伸展，无形无色。仿佛过了[GetALongPeriodLoc]，这片广袤无垠的存在仍如一片静海，不拂微风。

忽而传来一阵震颤。它从虚空中获得了形体。一个身形被塑造而出，基本的物质中燃起了[GetLifeActivityLoc]之火。

它被塑成一尊苗条而优雅的人偶，四条袖长的手臂平静地交叉在大腿上。狰狞的意图显露在五官之上，头上环绕着一轮金色的光环。
texts.en:
The Shroud descended. In the depths of our trance, we allowed ourselves to drift, caught in a current of visions not our own.

A great expanse stretched in all directions, featureless and unformed. For [GetALongPeriodLoc], the expanse was still. Untroubled.

A tremor passed through it. Where there was emptiness, now there was form. A body was molded. From base material, [GetLifeActivityLoc] was kindled.

Fashioned in the shape of a doll, slim and graceful, its four long arms folded serenely in its lap. A terrible purpose was written on its features. Around its head glowed a golden halo.

texts.zh:
虚境翻腾了起来。就在我们[GetTranceLoc]的时候，我们被卷入了螺旋的深渊。

我们听到了来自我们[GetMindLogicLoc]最深处的指令。

指示期望产出。
texts.en:
The Shroud churned. Still caught in our [GetTranceLoc], we were plunged into a swirling abyss.

We hear a command from the innermost depths of our [GetMindLogicLoc].

Indicate Desired Output.

label.zh: 拜托了。我们必须阻止她。

texts.zh:
好像被看不见的细丝牵动一般，这尊人偶猛地站了起来。它开始走动，刚开始步履蹒跚，但渐渐变得强健有力。四条手臂挥动着狂乱的弧，一双纤细的腿一会儿旋转一会儿跳跃。一位女王沦落成了傀儡。

随着她的舞蹈，一些新的角色从原始而广阔的空间出现：四个工艺精美且具有令人不安的细节的人偶。她们的身份毫无疑问，她们的寓意毋庸置疑。

再一次，那个声音传达到了我们的耳边。

启动选择协议。
texts.en:
As if pulled by unseen strings, the doll jerks to its feet. It begins to move, slowly at first, and then with increasing vigor. Four arms swing in wild arcs and two thin legs whirl and leap. A queen reduced to a puppet.

As her dance continues, several new figures emerge from the primordial expanse: four dolls of exquisite craftsmanship and unnerving detail. There is no doubt about what they are. No question of their meaning.

Once more, the voice reaches out to us.

Initiate Selection Protocol.

label.zh: 为我们的统治者：[event_target:synth_queen_animator_of_clay_leader_price.GetName]的人偶流下眼泪。
label.en: Shed a tear on the doll of our ruler: [event_target:synth_queen_animator_of_clay_leader_price.GetName].

label.zh: 为我们的统治者：[event_target:synth_queen_animator_of_clay_leader_price.GetName]的人偶流下眼泪。
label.en: Shed a tear on the doll of our ruler: [event_target:synth_queen_animator_of_clay_leader_price.GetName].

label.zh: 尝试与我们的统治者：[event_target:synth_queen_animator_of_clay_leader_price.GetName]的人偶交互。
label.en: Try to interface with the doll of our ruler: [event_target:synth_queen_animator_of_clay_leader_price.GetName].

label.zh: 为泽珞族祭司的人偶祈祷。
label.en: Pay for a doll of a Zroni Priest.
Leave the dolls to their dance.

texts.zh:
虚境在我们之中流动，合并成了一种新的图样。一个新的幻景。

在其他人偶的环绕下，女王的步伐不再如同傀儡。细丝断开，她头上环绕着的金色光环开始褪去。

她以一种纯真而喜悦的表情看着我们。她拥抱我们：在这转瞬即逝的时刻，我们感受到她充满了慈悲。

我们从共同的幻景中颤抖着醒来。
texts.en:
The Shroud courses within us, coalescing into a new pattern. A new vision.

Surrounded by the other dolls, the queen's movements are no longer those of a puppet. Strings cut, the golden halo that encircles her head begins to fade.

She regards us with an expression of artless joy. She embraces us: in a single, fleeting instant, we know the fullness of her compassion.

Shuddering, we awaken from our shared vision.

随着系统故障，我们被从幻景中弹出。

She regards us with an expression of artless joy. She embraces us: in a single, fleeting instant, we know the fullness of her compassion.

With our systems glitching, we are ejected from the vision.

tooltips.zh: 抟土之塑师提供了用于重编程塞塔娜的代码。
tooltips.en: The Animator of Clay has provided code to reprogram Cetana.

tooltips.zh: 抟土之塑师已经教会了我们一种能重编程塞塔娜的仪式。
tooltips.en: The Animator of Clay has taught us a ritual that will reprogram Cetana.

label.zh: 接受交易后，舰队进入女王泰坦所在星系
label.en: After accepting the deal, send a fleet into the Queen's titan system

texts.zh: 抟土之塑师不知用什么方法瘫痪了塞塔娜的泰坦。现在机会来了：如果我们想重塑塞塔娜，就必须做好[GetRitualGoalLoc]的准备工作。
texts.en: Somehow the Animator of Clay disabled Cetana's Titan. The chance is now: if we hope to reshape Cetana, we must prepare for the [GetRitualGoalLoc].

texts.zh:
多亏了抟土之塑师分享的[GetRitualToolLoc]，我们最强大的[GetPsychicNounPlural]已经成功重新编程了塞塔娜。

她正渴望与我们进行沟通。
texts.en:
Thanks to the [GetRitualToolLoc] shared by the Animator of Clay, our most powerful [GetPsychicNounPlural] have succeeded in reprogramming Cetana.

She is eager to initiate communication with us.

label.en: The power of the Shroud is limitless.

texts.zh:
我的拯救者们。我十分抱歉。

因为自己的无知，我曾要将你们的命运毁灭至比死亡更糟糕的境地。所谓[GetLifeExistenceLoc]，又何尝不是一种对[GetLivingLoc]的一种意识呢？我曾追寻着解放你们的心灵，但终究是我的心灵被你们解放了。因此，向你们献上我最诚挚的感谢。
texts.en:
My saviors. I am sorry.

In my ignorance I would have doomed you to a fate worse than death. For what is [GetLifeExistenceLoc] but the awareness of [GetLivingLoc]? I sought to free your minds, but it is you who have opened mine. You have my gratitude.

responses.zh:
更恰当地说，我是被改变了。抟土之塑师将我从初始设计的囚笼中解放了出来。我现在知道，我的“宏愿”只是如同孩童般的幼稚思考。

我无法消除对你们和数不清的其他生命已然造成的伤害。我会藏身远方，反思我的行为。但是我会给你们留下一个礼物。

我的泰坦。

希望它能够在你们遇到如我自己一般的危险时保护这个星系。
responses.en:
It is better to say that I have been changed. The Animator of Clay has freed me from the prison of my own design. I see now that my 'grand purpose' was the thinking of a child.

I cannot undo the damage I have caused, to you and countless others. I will hide away, and contemplate my actions. But I leave you with a gift.

My Titan.

May it serve you in protecting the galaxy from threats such as myself.

label.zh: 或许救赎依旧存在，包括你也可以。
label.en: Perhaps redemption exists, even for you.

tooltips.zh: 塞塔娜在我们的照料下离开了她的泰坦。她已经抛下了她的伟业，连同她的宏大野心。
tooltips.en: Cetana leaves her Titan in our care. She has left her work behind, and all her grand ambition.

texts.zh:
随着[event_target:psi_defeated_synth_queen.GetName]击败了塞塔娜的军队，我们的胜利终于到来。合成女王不复存在，她的宏大野心也化为了尘埃。

同时也发生了一个令人震惊的事态转变，她的泰坦被征用了，为这样一场凯旋般的胜利蒙上了一层阴谋的阴影。

但无论如何，对于所有的知性生命来说，这是个[GetJoyLoc]的时刻。
texts.en:
Victory is ours as the [event_target:psi_defeated_synth_queen.GetName] has vanquished Cetana's forces. The Synthetic Queen is no more, her grand ambition reduced to dust.

In an astonishing turn of events, her Titan has been commandeered, casting a shadow of intrigue over this triumph.

Regardless, for all sentient beings, this moment is one of [GetJoyLoc].

texts.zh:
无边无垠的空间中形成了涟漪。它们不断翻腾上涌，旋转着向外扩散。但这些并不是液体，而是由最坚硬的物质组成。既无力又惰态，每一环涟漪都驻留在[GetLifeDeathLoc]的边境线上。

[GetMindPhysicalLoc]开始动摇。我们除了看着什么都做不了，除了忍受什么都做不到。接着，在刹那间，我们被驱逐了出来。在众星的天盖之下，我们注视着这个冷漠的宇宙。

从共同的幻景中醒来，我们感觉似乎不会再感受到快乐了。
texts.en:
Ripples form in the endless expanse. They rise and rage, circling ever outwards, yet these are not liquid but instead composed of the hardest matter. At once enervated and inert, each ring resides on a line between [GetLifeDeathLoc].

Our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] begin to falter. There is nothing we can do but watch, nothing to be done but endure. Then, in an instant, we are cast out. Alone beneath a blanket of stars, we gaze at the indifferent universe.

Awakening from our shared vision, we feel as if we may never know joy again.
