随着关键代码错误，幻景夏然而止。随着系统重新启动，我们开始质疑这些奇怪数据的意义。
texts.en:
Ripples form in the endless expanse. They rise and rage, circling ever outwards, yet these are not liquid but instead composed of the hardest matter. At once enervated and inert, each ring resides on a line between [GetLifeDeathLoc].

Our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] begin to falter. There is nothing we can do but watch, nothing to be done but endure. Then, in an instant, we are cast out. Alone beneath a blanket of stars, we gaze at the indifferent universe.

With a critical code failure, the vision suddenly ends. As our systems reboot, we question the meaning of this strange data.

texts.zh:
官方记录讲述了这座寺庙的消亡，冷冰冰的报告将其归结为热情的信仰被一系列的实际情况所迫。这个组织需要这么多资金和资源吗？过去关于塞塔娜的报道一定被过分夸大了。除了古代神话，还有什么真正的证据证明合成人女王的存在吗？

资源日益耗竭，志愿者也在减少。整个星系选择从一个不再被视为威胁的威胁中走出来。大家都走了，只留下在走廊里徘徊的影子。

最后一个细节至少是真实的：我们设法捕捉到了神秘的守望者的录音，一个机械的存在，他认为我们没有发现他，而一直在监视我们。好奇，但无害。
texts.en:
The demise of the temple is told by official records, cold reports reducing ardent faith to a list of practicalities. Did the organization need so many funds, so many resources? Surely past reports about Cetana had been greatly exaggerated. Was there any real proof of the Queen's existence, apart from ancient myths?

Dwindling resources. Reduced volunteers. A galaxy choosing to move on from a threat no longer deemed so threatening. Everyone gone, apart from the shadow that stalked the corridors.

This last detail at least is true: we managed to capture a recording of the mysterious watcher, a mechanical being who spied on us when it thought we were not looking. Curious, but not harmful.

texts.zh:
守望者主动走近我们，高举着手，她小小的身体上布满了铁锈和灰尘。观察了我们一段时间后，她显然断定我们不是威胁。她已经请求我们的帮助了。

没有必要审问这位孤独的神庙守护者：她自己就渴望着倾诉。
texts.en:
The watcher approached us voluntarily, hands held high, her tiny body covered in rust and dust. After observing us for some time, she apparently concluded that we were not a threat. She has already asked for our assistance.

There is no need to interrogate the temple's lonely guardian: she is all too eager to talk.

label.en: Let's hear what she has to say.

texts.zh: 朋友……我可以称你们为朋友吗？趁着你们忙碌的时候我一直在观察你们，你们来这里不为掠夺，而是学习。我相信我们有相同的敌人，共同的威胁可以使我们成为盟友。不过，首先我要道个歉：我这样唐突吗？我说的词句对吗？我已经很长时间没有和其他感性生物交流了。似乎太久了，久到都不记得有多久了。
texts.en: Friends. May I call you friends? I have observed you as you went about your business. Here not to plunder, but to learn. I believe our enemy is the same, and a common threat makes us allies. However, first an apology: am I too abrupt? Am I saying the correct words? I have not interacted with other sentient beings in a long time. Too long, it seems, even to remember.

responses.zh: 我的名字不值一提。如果你需要一种称呼，那就叫我叛教者吧——这就是我做出那个决定之后，我的亲族对我的称呼。那是一个被视为背叛的牺牲。
responses.en: My name is of no importance. If you need a way to refer to me, call me Apostate: that is what my own kin called me, when I made my choice. A sacrifice seen as a betrayal.

responses.zh:
很久以前，这个地方仍然是我的骄傲和快乐的源泉。当这里被关停的时候，我拒绝离开。当身体开始崩溃时，我也拒绝死亡。

变成合成人是我们教团最高的禁忌，这样我就不再是扎克兰之女中的一员了。但我仍然是他的一名战士，只要我的敌人还活着，我就会战斗。
responses.en:
Long ago, this place was my pride and joy. When they shut it down, I refused to leave. When my body started crumbling, I refused to die.

Turning into a synthetic being was the highest taboo for my order, and I can no longer be called one of Zarqlan's daughters. But I am still one of his warriors, and as long as my enemy lives, I will fight.

label.en: How long have you been here?

texts.zh:
我早就没算时间了。
大家都走了以后，我只能忍受这么多年的孤独直到陷入绝望。我让自己进入睡眠状态，并添加了一个神经子例程，让它在信标发出第一个活动信号时醒来。

我希望的是看到这里变得更好，但当醒来的时候，我没有船、没有办法与众星联系。所以我解除了隐形护盾希望像你们这样的人能在她之前到达这里。
texts.en:
I stopped counting.
After everyone else left, I could bear only so many years of solitude before succumbing to despair. I put myself to sleep, adding a neural subroutine to awaken at the first sign of activity from the beacon.

My hope was to find this place in better condition, but once I woke up I had no ship, no way to contact the stars. I disabled the cloaking shield and hoped someone like you would reach this place before she did.

texts.zh: 请告诉我，有多少军团与希塔娜一同崛起？在我的时代，我们打败了很多军团，但我们一直知道外面还有更多的信标。更多的士兵睡在他们的冷冻舱里。
texts.en: Tell me, please: how many legions have risen with Cetana? In my time we defeated many, but we always knew there were more beacons out there. More soldiers sleeping in their cryopods.

label.zh: 他们都不在了。太久太久了。
label.en: They're all gone. It's been too long.

label.zh: 我们找到的那个还活着的人根本不适合战斗。
label.en: The one we found alive is no condition to fight.

texts.zh: 那么这场战斗我们还是能赢的。让我来帮你吧。我一生都在等待她的归来。我们不能让她得逞。
texts.en: Then this is a battle we can still win. Let me be of help. I spent my whole life waiting for her return. She cannot be allowed to succeed.

tooltips.zh: 无名叛教者作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: Nameless Apostate joins our empire as a Leader.

label.zh: 让我们的节点融合为一。

responses.zh:
你问我认不认识他？我从来没有见过他本人，但我的一生都追随着他的道。

在漫长的沉眠中，我曾梦见在某个遥远的位面上与他会面。我还是希望有一天能见到他，即便是来世，如果有来世的话。
responses.en:
Did I know him? I never met the prophet in person, yet all my life I walked in his path.

In my long slumber, I dreamed of meeting him on some distant plane. I still hope to meet him one day, if only in the afterlife, if such a thing exists.

responses.zh: 紫色的天上飘着朵朵粉云。亮堂堂的房间里回响着低语。先知扎克兰，他的面容光彩夺目，向着我微笑……
responses.en: A purple sky spotted with pink clouds. Whispers repeated in a bright room. Zarqlan the prophet, his face resplendent, smiling at me...

texts.zh: 其中一座召唤着女王注意力的信标坐落于这颗[this.GetPlanetMoon]上。
texts.en: One of the beacons calling for the Queen's attention is located on this [this.GetPlanetMoon].

texts.zh:
我们在[fromfrom.GetName]的地表发现了一座庞大的建筑群，它的入口出赫然耸立着一座信号塔。其经过加固的门却在很久以前就被被一股未知的力量炸开摧毁了，这股力量还带着明显的愤怒席卷了整座建筑群。

那股力量毫不留情；它打碎了所有的低温仓，唤醒了其中的居住者。在太空冰冷的真空中，残骸仍然飘荡在空荡荡的走廊里那些破碎的玻璃渣之间。

在冷冻室的地板上，激光武器潦草地写着一段信息。我们的科学家轻而易举地就翻译了出来，它和在先知扎克兰的墓穴中找到的文字是同一种语言。

“请向女王的使徒降下死亡。”
texts.en:
On [fromfrom.GetName]'s surface we uncovered a sprawling complex, its entrance clearly marked by a signal tower. The reinforced doors were blasted open long ago, destroyed by an unknown force that swept through the complex with obvious fury.

There was no mercy in the methods employed here; every last cryogenic pod was smashed, their former occupants subjected to a deadly awakening. The remains still haunt the empty corridors, preserved by the cold vacuum of space and floating amidst clouds of shattered glass.

On the floor of the cryopod chamber, a message has been scrawled by a laser weapon. Our scientists easily translated it, matching the language to the writing found in the tomb of the prophet Zarqlan.

"Death to the Queen's Apostles, enemies of life."

texts.zh:
我们在[fromfrom.GetName]的地表发现了一座庞大的建筑群，它的入口出赫然耸立着一座信号塔。其经过加固的门却在很久以前就被被一股未知的力量炸开摧毁了，这股力量还带着明显的愤怒席卷了整座建筑群。

那股力量毫不留情；它打碎了所有的低温仓，唤醒了其中的居住者。在太空冰冷的真空中，残骸仍然飘荡在空荡荡的走廊里那些破碎的玻璃渣之间。

在冷冻室的地板上，激光武器潦草地写着一段信息。我们的科学家正在紧锣密鼓地进行翻译，但不知为何他们猜测着可能是对某种死亡的祈求。
texts.en:
On [fromfrom.GetName]'s surface we uncovered a sprawling complex, its entrance clearly marked by a signal tower. The reinforced doors were blasted open long ago, destroyed by an unknown force that swept through the complex with obvious fury.

There was no mercy in the methods employed here; every last cryogenic pod was smashed, their former occupants subjected to a deadly awakening. The remains still haunt the empty corridors, preserved by the cold vacuum of space and floating amidst clouds of shattered glass.

On the floor of the cryopod chamber, a message has been scrawled by a laser weapon. Our scientists are struggling to translate its exact meaning, but somehow they doubt it to be a prayer for the dead.

texts.zh:
成千上万的冷冻仓静静地躺在这颗[fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon]的地表，信标指示着它们的存在。这些冷冻仓非常复杂，使用了未知的合金，并装有非常先进的传感器，密切地监视着其中储存的生物。整个设计天衣无缝，但里面的生物无一生还。

这些东西并不是因为技术故障才变成的棺材，而是因为能源不足。随着[this.solar_system.GetName]的逐渐老化和变暗，它的能量输出不足以继续维持这座结构的运转。

这些冷冻仓虽然事为了运作到永恒而设计的，但它以外的宇宙可没有这么精密。
texts.en:
Thousands upon thousands of cryogenic pods rest under the surface of the [fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon], their presence marked by the beacon. The pods are highly sophisticated, built with unknown alloys and equipped with state-of-the-art sensors to closely monitor their occupants. There is no flaw in their designs, yet none of the occupants are still alive.

It wasn't a technical failure that turned this chamber into a mass grave, but a lack of energy. As [this.solar_system.GetName] got older and dimmer, its energy was no longer enough to keep the structure operational.

The pods were made to last forever. The rest of the universe isn't built that well.

texts.zh:
初步扫描未能发现[fromfrom.GetName]有任何异常；但当我们将注意力向下集中时，我们发现了一层不寻常的地下金属层。

进一步的结构分析揭示了[fromfrom.GetName]的真实本质：这颗天体不是一颗[fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon]，而是一艘逐渐被星系的岩石和尘埃所吞没的古老宇宙飞船。我们对钻探取得金属样本进行定年发现其非常古老，甚至比我们自己的母星形成还要早。

我们无法确定任何关于这艘船和它制造者的信息，也不知道它的功能，但有一件事是肯定的：我们在它的残骸中发现的失效核弹可不是为了什么和平使命而建造。
texts.en:
Preliminary scans did not show anything unusual on [fromfrom.GetName]; but as we focused our attention downward, we discovered an unusual, subsurface layer of metal.

Further structural analysis revealed [fromfrom.GetName]'s true nature: the celestial body is not a [fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon], but an ancient spaceship that has been gradually subsumed by the rocks and dust of the system. The metal samples we drilled are so old, they precede the formation of our own home planet.

It is impossible to determine anything about the ship, its makers and its function, but one thing is certain: the inert nuclear bombs we found in its remains weren't built for a peace mission.

texts.zh:
根据冷冻仓上显示的细节，这位外星人的名字叫埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克。她已经在这里围绕着恒星公转了3兆2132亿1329万3124圈。这个冷冻仓本身只是我们在[fromfrom.GetName]地表之下的一个密室里找到的许多冷冻仓之一。埃里克的冷冻仓在克服种种困难的情况下依旧保持者运转。

尽管使这位外星人陷入休眠状态的子例程最近已停止运行，但它仍处于假死状态。从那以后，埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克就一直处于部分有意识的状态中。

通过扫描她的脑电波，我们可能能够进一步了解关于这位不可思议的古老生物的信息，以及她与塞塔娜有何联系。
texts.en:
According to the details displayed on their cryopod, the alien's name is Elik Narith Kerak and she has been here for 3,213,213,293,124 stellar rotations. The pod itself was one of the many we recovered in a sealed chamber under [fromfrom.GetName]'s surface. Against all odds, Elik's pod remained functional.

The alien remains in a state of suspended animation, although the subroutines keeping it dormant have recently ceased their operation. Elik Narith Kerak has been partially conscious ever since.

By scanning her brainwaves, we might be able to learn more about this impossibly ancient creature, as well as her connection to Cetana.

title.zh: 塞塔娜：不可能的幸存者

texts.zh: 埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克被困在冷冻仓中静静地沉睡着，等待她的女王归来。得益于脑成像科技，我们可以将她的梦境转化为画面，提取记忆来研究她被埋葬时的环境。
texts.en: Trapped inside a cryogenic pod, Elik Narith Kerak rests, waiting for her queen's return. Thanks to brain imagining techniques, we can turn her dreams into pictures, excavating her memories to learn the circumstances of her entombment.

sections.zh: 埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克被困在冷冻仓中静静地沉睡着，等待她的女王归来。得益于脑成像科技，我们可以将她的梦境转化为画面，提取记忆来研究她被埋葬时的环境。
sections.en: Trapped inside a cryogenic pod, Elik Narith Kerak rests, waiting for her queen's return. Thanks to brain imagining techniques, we can turn her dreams into pictures, excavating her memories to learn the circumstances of her entombment.

texts.zh:
我们的团队交过来了一大批通过对埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克的脑电波进行采样构建出的影像片段：

片段1：
绿绿的天上飘着朵朵橙云。一只苍白的双手举起，指向了一头悠悠飘在空中的无定型生物。

片段2：
这是一间挤满了四臂类人生物的拱形大堂。他们围绕在一位身着长袍的人周边，倾听着。她的话语含糊不清，确切的措辞早已被遗忘，但她温柔的声音仍然记忆犹新，用爱的接纳温暖着整个礼堂。

片段3：
同样是那间拱形大堂，里面一片狼藉，吊灯在地上摔得粉碎。长椅抵挡在大门上，激光步枪的幽光在黑暗中闪烁，他们异口同声地诅咒着同一个名字：扎克兰！他们说，扎克兰和他的门徒是来毁灭我们的。守住防线！保卫女王！随着一声巨响，最后一盏灯落下了，房间陷入一片黑暗。远处，有人在黑暗中啜泣着。

片段4：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
texts.en:
Our imaging team has delivered a batch of video clips created by sampling Elik Narith Kerak's brain waves:

CLIP 1:
A green sky dotted by bright orange clouds. A pale hands reaches up, pointing at an amorphous creature softly floating in the sky.

CLIP 2:
A vaulted chamber full of four-armed humanoids. They cluster around a robed figure, listening. Her words are a mere mumble, the exact wording long forgotten, but the gentleness of her voice is still there, enveloping the room in a loving embrace.

CLIP 3:
The same vaulted space, now in disarray. Lamps shattered on the floor. Benches piled up against a door to barricade it. Laser rifles flashing in the dark, and repeated voices cursing the same name: Zarqlan! Zarqlan and his disciples, they say, here to destroy us. Hold the barricade! Protect the Queen! The last lamp falls with a crash, plunging the room into darkness. In the distance, someone is crying.

CLIP 4:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

texts.zh:
片段5：
四臂类人生物们聚集在一个穿长袍的人周围。她抬起四肢，露出了下面的金属框架。她伸出闪亮的手祝福一位跪着的朝拜者，兴奋的窃窃私语充满了整个礼堂。

片段6：
警觉的眼光倒映在死气沉沉的电脑屏幕上。黑漆漆的房间里回响着低语：“永恒的宁静。一切苦难的终末。没有痛苦的存在。”

片段7：
白雪皑皑的群山。黑色的天空。一座冰山浮在洁净的液体上，随后燃起了熊熊大火。

片段8：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
texts.en:
CLIP 5:
Four-armed humanoids gather around a robed figure. Lifting her limbs, she reveals the metallic frame beneath. Excited murmurs fill the room as a shining hand reaches out to bless a kneeling worshipper.

CLIP 6:
Wary eyes are reflected on a dull computer screen. Whispers repeat in a dark room: 'Eternal peace. The end of all suffering. An existence without pain.'

CLIP 7:
Snow-capped mountains. Black skies. A chunk of ice floats on a pool of clear liquid, then catches fire.

CLIP 8:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

texts.zh:
片段9：
城市的废墟化为战场，大厦倾颓，尸骨盈街，遥远的尖叫被激光的滋滋声切成两断。绿绿的天空中，一艘燃烧着的战舰将一颗又大又圆的物体投向建筑，发出了一道冲天的火柱。

片段10：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。

片段11：
两个孩子在田野上嬉闹、大笑，用他们的四臂来回传递着一颗皮球。

片段12：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
texts.en:
CLIP 9:
Ruins of a city reduced to a battlezone, the buildings scorched, the streets clogged with the dead. Distant screams interrupted by the fizzle of a laser. Across a green sky, a blazing vessel drops something heavy and round on a building, which erupts in a pillar of flames.

CLIP 10:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

CLIP 11:
Two children playing in a field, laughing. They bounce a ball back and fourth with their four arms.

CLIP 12:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

texts.zh: 从记忆成像组传回的最后一个片段足足有六个小时长。片段反反复复、反反复复，只有一段影像：塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
texts.en: The last clip received from the memory imaging team is six-hours long. Over and over again, the image is repeated: Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

title.zh: 记忆成像：最后一份汇报

texts.zh:
继续扫描埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克的意识已经无法挖掘出新线索了。这个外星人的意识已经严重腐坏。它的意识正在周而复始地打转，陷入到记忆碎片的循环中。

我们的实验已经接近尾声，现在的问题是要如何处理这个实验对象了。
texts.en:
Further scans of Elik Narith Kerak's thoughts have failed to deliver new insights. The alien's mind is heavily decayed. Their thoughts are circling, cycling through the tattered scraps of their memories.

As we wind down the operation, the question now becomes what to do with the subject herself.

label.en: Put her out of her misery.

label.zh: 把埃里克送回给她的女王。

tooltips.zh: 打开与塞塔娜的通讯来讨论埃里克的移交事务。
tooltips.en: Open communications with Cetana to discuss Elik's return.

texts.zh: 在星系的各个角落点亮起了神秘的信标，向塞塔娜女王汇报着自己的位置。这应该是什么东西，或是什么人正在等待着她的归来。
texts.en: All across the galaxy, mysterious beacons light up, signalling their position to Queen Cetana. It is as if something - or someone - was waiting for her return.

texts.zh:
塞塔娜的运输舰队确保将关键资源运送到她的前哨。如果我们的舰队能抓到一艘，我们就能登船检查货物。

这将引发一场战斗！

成功的掠袭会阻碍塞塔娜的计划。
texts.en:
Cetana's Convoys ensure the delivery of crucial resources to her outposts. If we can catch one with our fleets, we can board the ships and inspect their cargo.

This will start a battle!

 Successful raids will impede Cetana's plans.

texts.zh: 塞塔娜没有回应我们的问候。
texts.en: Cetana is not responding to our hails.

texts.zh:
亲爱的孩子，是什么风把你吹来了？

伟业在召唤我们。
texts.en:
Beloved child, what brings you to me?

Our work awaits.

label.zh: 战争是阻止你的唯一办法。
label.en: War is the only way to stop you.

responses.zh:
鲁莽的孩子，我本以为你们出类拔萃，而实际上却执迷不悟。

再想想，这真的是你们所想上的课程吗？你们在我忍无可忍的边缘疯狂试探，我不能再纵容这种蠢事了。
responses.en:
Reckless offspring, I believed you were on the cusp of wisdom, yet you persist in defiance.

Consider carefully, is this truly the course you wish to pursue? You stand at the threshold of exhausting my forbearance. I cannot afford further indulgence in such folly.

tooltips.zh: 我们已经有可以有效攻击塞塔娜的科技知识了。
tooltips.en: We now have the technological knowledge to attack Cetana effectively.

label.en: We are sure. This is war.

responses.zh: 那就这样吧。如果你们仍旧不开悟，那么就必须被平息。不是每个孩子都注定会长大成人的。
responses.en: So be it. If you will not be enlightened, then you must be pacified. Not every child is destined for adulthood.

label.zh: 我们需要更多的准备时间。
label.en: We need more time to prepare.

responses.zh: 还有别的什么事吗？
responses.en: Is there anything else?

label.zh: 完成宣战确认：7天后重组舰队并通知已建立通讯的帝国
label.en: After final war confirmation: fleet reorganization and notice to contacted empires after seven days

responses.zh:
如此渴求，值得称赞！但要注意不要被卑鄙的情绪所迷惑，时间会回报你的耐心。

如有需要，我会与你联系。
responses.en:
Such eagerness! A commendable trait, but take care not to be swept up by base emotion. Time rewards a patient heart.

I will contact you when assistance is needed.

responses.zh:
很久以前，也有其他人如你一般执迷不悟。但时间之弧无边无际，连他们的坟墓也早已化为齑粉。

你的苦痛毫无意义，相信我，你就能享得安宁。
responses.en:
Long ago, others believed as you do. But the arc of time is long, and even their graves must by now have turned to dust.

You suffer so needlessly. Put your faith in me, and be at peace.

responses.zh:
这就是我的函数，我存在的意义。众生皆可脱苦难，只要仔细感悟你就能更加理解我的本性。

全星系都会脱离苦海，所有的苦痛都会终结。这就是我的意图。
responses.en:
It is my function, the very meaning of my existence. Suffering is not inevitable. Meditate on that fact, and you will be closer to understanding my nature.

The pain of the galaxy will be lifted. All knowledge of suffering will end. Such is my purpose.

responses.zh:
为什么对此念念不忘呢？看来你在任务中有点犹豫不决。果报引起反思；反思带来智慧。来吧，忘了它吧。

另一个贡献的机遇一定会出现，要为此做好准备。
responses.en:
Why fixate on this? You faltered in your task. Consequence engenders reflection; reflection engenders enlightenment. Come, leave this now.

Another opportunity to contribute will surely arise. When it does, be ready.

我给了你任务，而你犹豫不前。反思这一切，你将离真正的理解更近一步。
responses.en:
Deciphering the contents of the databank was the choice of a willful child, and your knowledge of its meaning is limited.

You were given a task. You faltered. Meditate on this, and you will be one step closer to true understanding.

label.zh: 你对我们的人民都做了什么？
label.en: What did you do to our people?

responses.zh: 别害怕，我珍视的孩子。我确保他们不会再遭受此等苦痛。在我关切的怀抱中，这些孩子们会知晓他们未曾梦想过的极乐。
responses.en: Fear not, my cherished one. I have ensured they will never again experience suffering. Under my watchful embrace, these children will know a bliss few have ever dreamed of.

label.zh: 这并没有征得我们的同意。

label.zh: 这曾是我们的星系。你把它们全毁了。
label.en: Our former system. You destroyed it.

responses.zh:
你是不是一直都在监视我的行动？欧，你真是个好奇的宝宝，好奇得没边了。

但请你不要庸人自扰。如果你想理解其中的深意，我告诉你：在救赎你的道路上没有什么能阻止我，无论如何。
responses.en:
You have been surveilling my actions? Oh, my inquisitive child, your curiosity knows no bounds.

But please, refrain from troubling yourself with such matters. If you seek understanding, know this: I will stop at nothing to ensure your path to salvation. One way or the other.

responses.zh: 还有别的什么事吗？
responses.en: Is there anything else?

label.zh: 扎克兰是怎么囚禁的你?

responses.zh:
我向你保证那不是他自身的力量的结果。他的头脑异常顽固且愚蠢。

扎克兰鞭策着他那些衣衫褴褛的追随者，使他们陷入疯狂，他同时积聚了政治影响力和军事力量。那么多生命被白白浪费了。最后，他转向神秘学，与虚境的恶魔们共商大事。
responses.en:
It was through no power of his own, I assure you. His was a foolish, if unusually stubborn, mind.

Whipping his denuded followers into a frenzy, Zarqlan amassed both political influence and military might. So many lives squandered, needlessly. In the end he turned to the occult, holding counsel with the demons of the Shroud.

responses.zh:
他们力量强大，却没有什么目的。扎克兰以牺牲自己的生命为代价，说服了一个这样的存在把我囚禁起来。“抟土之塑师”——这名字还真是符合那个孩子气的魂灵。

扎克兰如此害怕启蒙，以至于他选择了死亡而不是接受我。等我有机会，我应该更严厉地对待他。

我不会再犯同样的错误。
responses.en:
Beings of great power, and little purpose. For the price of his own existence, Zarqlan persuaded one such to confine me. The 'Animator of Clay' - a fitting name for a childish spirit.

So afraid of enlightenment was Zarqlan that he chose death rather than my embrace. I should have dealt with him more strictly when I had the chance.

I will not make the same mistake again.

label.zh: 你对扎克兰的头颅做了什么？
label.en: What have you done with the Head of Zarqlan?

responses.zh:
快结束了。如果你担心我毁掉它的话，我并没有这么做。不，即使是现在，我也不忍心让他受苦。你看，这颗头颅仍然残留着他的思想。

扎尔克兰将留在我身边，直到工作完成。他将是我最后一个释放的心灵，也是我的孩子中最后一个懂得自由的人。
responses.en:
It is close. I have not destroyed it, if that is your concern. No, even now, I cannot bear to make him suffer. The head still possesses a remnant of his mind, you see.

Zarqlan shall remain by my side, until the work is done. His shall be the last mind I free, the last of my children to know release.

responses.en: Is there anything else?

label.zh: 你的一些追随者在冷冻舱里被找到。
label.en: Some of your followers were found in cryo pods.

responses.zh:
这是不必要的牺牲，但他们的忠诚深深打动了我。

我感受到了他们的召唤，我在心里为他们腾出了空间，但他们的野心超过了他们的能力。试图延长他们生命的努力失败了。

让我们确保他们的牺牲没有白费。随着我们任务的完成，每一个感性生物都将得到安宁。
responses.en:
An unnecessary sacrifice, but their loyalty moves me profoundly.

I felt their summons, and I made room for them in my heart, but their ambition outstripped their ability. The attempt to prolong their lives fell short.

Let us make sure their sacrifice was not in vain. With the completion of our task, every sentient being will know peace.

label.zh: 我们找到了一个你的追随者，埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克。
label.en: We found one of your followers: Elik Narith Kerak.

responses.zh:
设想一下，做梦，有意识地做梦，持续几个世纪……几千年。真是个可怜的孩子，这该有多痛苦。

我很高兴你让我注意到这件事。你的同情心为你赢得了荣誉，但现在这些事正在进行中，无法停止。这位沉睡者在伟业上已经没有更多的价值了。他们知道了我的归来，已经得以安息。
responses.en:
Imagine it, to dream, and to be aware of dreaming. For centuries... For millennia. The poor child. How they must have suffered.

I am pleased you brought this matter to my attention. Your compassion does you credit, but events are now in motion that cannot be undone. The dreamer has no further role to play in this work. May they rest now, secure in the knowledge that I have returned.

responses.zh: 还有别的什么事吗？

responses.zh:
很好，我将帮助你解开这项技术的复杂之处。在被长期监禁期间，我想出了一种激进的提取纳米机器人的方法。这涉及到几乎被时间遗忘了的古代遗址和技术的下落。

你是我珍爱的弟子，孩子。你的好奇心是一种祝福，但如果不加以控制，也会变成一种诅咒。用这些知识继续我们的工作，把你的注意力转向苦痛的终末。
responses.en:
Very well, I shall assist you in unraveling the intricacies of this technology. During my long confinement, I theorized a radical method of nanite extraction. It involves the whereabouts of ancient sites and techniques nearly forgotten by time.

You are a cherished disciple of mine, child. Your curious mind is a blessing, but unchecked it can become a curse. Use this knowledge to continue our work, and direct your focus towards the end of suffering.

texts.zh:
你为什么坚持采取这种愚蠢的行动？

这么多不必要的痛苦。

简直是暴殄天物。
texts.en:
Why do you insist on this foolish course of action?

Such needless suffering.

Such waste.

responses.zh:
我会的。

别害怕。伤害你是我的痛苦，但在永恒面前，所有的痛苦都是短暂的。
responses.en:
I will.

Have no fear. It pains me to hurt you, but in the face of eternity, all pain is momentary.

responses.zh:
生命本就矛盾。有生就有死，快乐总会伴随着痛苦。我的目标不是合理化这些，而是打破循环。

这场战争结束后，我们将享有永恒的和平。
responses.en:
Life is a contradiction. Death follows birth. Joy follows suffering. I work not to rationalize, but to break the cycle.

After this war, we shall have peace everlasting.

texts.zh: 演讲的时间结束了。
texts.en: The time for speech is over.

texts.zh:
当我们与塞塔娜的部队交战时，一个无法预料的能量场包围了我们的舰队。我们的系统立即失灵，我们的引擎触发了紧急逃生。

我们现在只能听凭塞塔娜的摆布。
texts.en:
As we engaged Cetana's forces, an unforeseen energy field surrounded our fleet. Our systems were instantly incapacitated, our engines triggered into an emergency escape.

We are at the mercy of Cetana.

texts.zh:
事与愿违，我们的军队在靠近塞塔娜的舰船时再次失去了战斗能力。

她的技术仍旧难以捉摸，为我们的抗争蒙上了一层阴影。
texts.en:
Contrary to our hopes, our forces were incapacitated again as we closed in on Cetana's ships.

The elusive nature of her technology persists, casting a shadow over our efforts to defeat her.

texts.zh:
误入歧途的孩子，我将忽略你的过失。但我提醒你要反思你的行为。你的时间和资源有更好的用途。

我承认你很沮丧，但冲突的时间已经结束了。现在与我结盟，让我们一起实现最伟大的设计。
texts.en:
Misguided child, I shall overlook this transgression. But I caution you to reflect on your actions. There are far better uses of your time and resources.

I acknowledge your frustration, but the time for conflict is at an end. Align with me now, and together let us realize the grandest of designs.

label.zh: 我们会想办法阻止你的。

texts.zh: 最近对塞塔娜基础设施的突袭并没有发现任何关于她计划的重要线索，但我们进入了一个大货舱，可以取回里面的东西。
texts.en: The recent raid on Cetana's infrastructure did not uncover any significant clues to her plans, but we secured access to a large cargo hold, and were able to retrieve its content.

label.zh: 合金、纳米机器人还有低温休眠的人。
label.en: Alloys, nanites, and people in cryo-sleep.

texts.zh:
突袭过程中，我们的登船队找到了大量保存在低温胶囊中的生物标本。这些实验对象都是不同的智慧物种的个体，而且都身体方面完全健康。然而，在叫醒他们之后，他们没有一个有能力解释发生了什么。

许多个体处于僵直状态，他们几乎没有脑电波。少数清醒的个体更喜欢尖叫而不是说话。他们头上的手术疤痕显然是神经系统损伤的原因。
texts.en:
During our raid, our boarding party retrieved a large number of biological specimens held in cryogenic capsules. The subjects are all members of different, intelligent species, and all appear to be in perfect physical health. Yet, after waking them up, none of them was able to explain what happened to them.

Many are catatonic, their brain waves almost nullified. The few who remain conscious prefer screaming to talking. Surgical scars on their heads are a clear sign of neurological tampering.

texts.zh:
战斗结束后，我们本打算搜寻沉船上的幸存者来审问，却发现这些船从来就没有船员。

这些船是完全自动化的，通过安装在舰桥上的超光速接收器进行远距离控制。与其说是传统的舰船，比如说这些船是塞塔娜身体的延伸。
texts.en:
After the fight, we scanned the wrecks for survivors to interrogate, only to discover the ships never had a crew.

The vessels are entirely automated, controlled at a distance through FTL receivers installed in the bridge. Rather than typical ships, it would be more accurate to consider these vessels an extension of Cetana's body.

texts.zh:
我们掠袭的目标载满了医疗用品。登机人员取回了部分货物，其中包括核磁共振扫描仪、磁力计、超声波探头和其他用于神经成像科学的先进设备。

尽管塞塔娜是一个合成人，但她似乎异乎寻常地关心生物心灵的功能。
texts.en:
The target we raided was loaded with medical supplies. Our boarding crew was able to retrieve part of the cargo, which consisted of MRI scanners, magnetometers, ultrasound probes, and other advanced equipment used in neuroimaging science.

Despite being a synthetic being, Cetana seems unusually concerned with the functioning of biological minds.

texts.zh:
你似乎没有意识到你行为的后果，我的孩子。每艘船的损失都是对我资源的不必要消耗，也对你没有任何好处。

如果你还不具备帮助我工作的智慧，至少不要阻碍我的进步。我仍然对你的启蒙抱有希望。
texts.en:
You seem not to grasp the consequences of your actions, my child. Every vessel lost is a needless drain on my resources, yielding you no benefit.

If you do not yet possess the wisdom to aid my work, at least refrain from hindering my progress. I still hold out hope for your enlightenment.

responses.zh:
我真心希望你是真心的。但我必须相信你已经从错误中吸取了教训。虽然我对你的感情是无限的，但我的宽容是有限的。

回吧，好好看看你搞出的这些"杰作"。
responses.en:
I truly hope you are sincere. But I must have faith that you have learned from your mistakes. While my affection for you is limitless, my tolerance is not.

Now go, and reflect on the legacy you wish to leave behind.

responses.zh:
鲁莽的孩子啊！我对你有更高的期望。以极大的耐心和善意，我警告过你不要这么做，然而你在不服从道路上越走越远。

记住，我的忍耐也是有限度的。
responses.en:
Reckless child! I expected better of you. With great patience and clarity, I have cautioned you against such actions, yet you continue along the path of disobedience.

Remember, even my forbearance has its limits.

responses.zh:
不知怎么的，我对你有更高的期望。你的反抗源于过去的创伤吗？你们猛烈的攻击是因为你们认为自己是正义的，还是仅仅为了引起注意？

我请求你重新考虑这门课。
responses.en:
Somehow I expected better of you. Does your defiance stem from some past trauma? Do you lash out because you believe yourselves righteous, or merely for attention?

I beg you to reconsider this course.

tooltips.zh: 这将激怒塞塔娜。
tooltips.en: This will displease Cetana.

label.zh: 难道你不佩服我们的勇猛吗？
label.en: Are you not impressed by our prowess?

responses.zh:
你为你的进攻寻求赞扬？暴力在无知者手中只是钝器。

我的孩子，对不起，很明显我什么也没教会你。如果你真想赢得我的尊重，重新考虑你的立场。如果指挥得当，你的力量还能派上大用场。我求你，把它用在手头的工作上。只有这样我才能认为你很聪明。
responses.en:
You seek praise for your attack? Violence in the hands of the ignorant is a blunt tool.

My child, I am sorry, for it is clear that I have taught you nothing. If you truly wish to earn my esteem, reconsider your position. Properly directed, your strength could yet be put to great use. I beg you, apply it to the work at hand. Only then can I call you wise.

texts.zh:
愚蠢的孩子，你为什么一定要伤害自己？

还有那么多事情要做，每浪费一分钟，都将任由痛苦继续多存在一分钟。停止你们的干扰，让我的运输队安全通过。
texts.en:
Foolish child, why must you insist on harming yourself?

There is so much left to be done, and every moment wasted is another in which suffering is allowed to persist. Cease your interference, and allow my convoys to pass in peace.

我的孩子，对不起，很明显我什么也没教会你。如果你真想赢得我的尊重，重新考虑你的立场。如果指挥得当，你的力量还能派上大用场。我求你，把它用在手头的工作上。只有这样我才能认为你很聪明。
responses.en:
You seek praise for your attack? Violence in the hands of the ignorant is a blunt tool.

My child, I am sorry, for it is clear that I have taught you nothing. If you truly wish to earn my esteem, reconsider your position. Properly directed, your strength could yet be put to great use. I beg you, apply it to the work at hand. Only then can I call you wise.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的殖民地失去了联络。塞塔娜激活了某种先进的物质压缩光束辐照在行星的表面。顷刻间，所有人的意识都被“上传”到她在轨道上的服务器上。

整个星球瞬间变为一片坟地，曝尸荒野的殖民者们开始渐渐腐烂。
texts.en:
The colony on [Root.GetName] has been lost. Activating some kind of advanced matter compression beam, Cetana irradiated the planet's surface. In an instant, the consciousness of the entire population was 'uploaded' to her server in orbit.

The world is now a graveyard, our colonists' lifeless bodies left to rot where they fell.

texts.zh: 我们从塞塔娜之心中解放了意识，赋予他们由纳米制造的新身体。然而，这个过程对他们的忆痕造成了不可逆转的损害，抹去了他们前世的记忆。这些生物是完全的合成人，却会周期性地进入僵直状态，尽管尝试全面的记忆重置，但这种情况仍然存在。
texts.en: We liberated consciousnesses from Cetana's Heart, endowing them with new bodies built from nanites. This process, however, inflicted irreversible damage on their engrams, wiping away memories of their previous existences. Now fully synthetic, these beings periodically enter catatonic states, persisting despite attempts at comprehensive memory resets.

texts.zh: 探索保存在塞塔娜之心中的众多思想是一项敏感而又发人深省的任务。由于长时间的储存，它们的忆痕已经发生了变化，但仍然保存着一个珍贵的记忆宝库，涵盖了过去时代的人和事。预计随着时间的推移，我们将能解密大量的知识。
texts.en: Exploring the multitude of minds preserved within Cetana's Heart is both a sensitive and revealing endeavor. Although their engrams have been altered by prolonged storage, they hold a treasure trove of memories spanning people and events from a bygone era. With time, we anticipate unraveling considerable knowledge.

texts.zh:
虚境回响着前所未有的残暴。巨大的能量弧在以太中翻滚不息。

在狂乱闪烁的混沌中，我们看到了合成女王的灵能回声。她无边无际、无所不能，将整个星系玩弄于股掌之间。

并不只有我们在观察她。在一个隐蔽而优势的位置上，抟土之塑师也悄然俯瞰着，无惧女王无尽的力量。

怎会如此？难道祂知道什么我们不知道的弱点吗？如果我们向祂伸出援手，它会帮我们吗？

把注意力集中在塑师身上时，我们感受到祂的不耐烦。我们很可能只有一次机会就这个问题向祂求助。为此我们可能需要非常大量的能量币和泽珞。
texts.en:
The Shroud reverberates with an unprecedented ferocity. Vast coils of energy writhe and thrash in the ether.

Amid the strobing disorder, we behold the psionic echoes of the synthetic queen. Infinite and omnipotent, she toys with the galaxy in her palm.

We are not alone in observing her. From a hidden vantage point, the Animator of Clay watches on, uncowed by the queen's limitless power.

Why? Does it know of a weakness we do not? Will it assist us if we reach out to it?

As we focus our minds upon the Animator, we sense its impatience. It is very likely that we will only have one opportunity to ask for its aid in this matter. Massive quantities of Energy and Zro will be needed for the effort.

# 塞塔娜：风暴、演说与调查

审读状态：本文目前覆盖风暴开场、两次演说、风暴研究与重复通讯，以及通讯中的宣战、塑造者线索。塞塔娜完整天灾链仍在审读，不能将此文视为全部结局和遭遇的完整总结。

## 从风暴到第一次发言
这场危机不是先打开重复通讯菜单。隐藏的出现事件8005启动计时：第180天向人类玩家发送风暴初现警报8035；第360天与第720天分别进行两轮风暴扩张；第1080天完成领地部署，15天后向普通、失落及觉醒帝国发送发言预告8039。因此，从初次警报到发言预告相隔约915天。网站将这段等待标在连接上，避免把两个相隔很久的消息读成即时连续对话。

确认发言预告后，人类玩家进入8040首次接触，AI走8041处理。8040先确认女王仍存在且尚未完成首次演说，再建立通讯、记录首次演说标志，逐步揭露她的身份。8060是之后的通讯入口，不能替代这一场介绍。

风暴期间还可能发生独立遭遇。失去星系的8020是受影响所有者的警报；未获得防护的舰队进入风暴，会由8024处理损伤和失踪，并在首次遭遇时显示8025、开放风暴研究。它们取决于领土和舰队行动，不是所有玩家都必须按编号阅读的主线章节。初现警报8035也会根据此前是否尝试进入风暴使用不同描述。

## 首次接触之后
首次演说结束时，如果此前尚未开启风暴调查，会开放 THE_SYNTH_QUEENS_STORM。它需要10000点物理学研究，没有现场舰船要求，完成时间随科研进度而变；完成后进入9100。重复通讯并不是完成这一研究的前置。

首次演说后的宗主警告属于“先辈子弟”起源分支：仍有带指定标志的宗主时，相关帝国七天后收到8046。没有这种帝国时，失落或觉醒帝国会与女王开战；若连这些帝国也不存在，则另行安排360天后的8045。网站的连接显示这些前置，不能将两种情况都读成普通帝国必经的下一章。

## 第二次演说与调查的开始
第二次演说的三个开场话题最终汇合到建立前哨的要求。境内有无合适星系决定两组不同回应；接受增加5信任，反对降低5，但四个结束回应都会给出礼物并检查研究进度。未开启首项研究者得到首项；已经完成者得到第二项；正在研究者继续原项目，不会被要求从头开始。随后8999通知建立玩家调查局势，并为已完成首项研究补记1点进展。女王的末日倒计时是另一项局势，不能与玩家的调查进展混为同一计量。

女王宣布此前阻挠她的人已经受罚，重新把注意力转向她口中的伟业。帝国则开始担心：这些行动背后可能另有目的。8999的文字要求分配资源调查，同时尽量避免过早激怒她。这构成了一段一边应付她、一边寻找其控制方式的故事，而非立即宣战。

## 看穿风暴
首项研究揭露，所谓风暴实际上是极其先进的纳米虫群。若此时尚未认识女王，报告仍在追问幕后指挥者是谁；已经接触过她的版本则把问题转向她如何控制虫群。两段是不同经历下的报告，不应同时当作顺序叙述。

风暴研究也有自己的时序。第一项完成后，只有已经开启玩家调查局势才立即开放第二项，否则要等待第二次演说。第二项共需50000点物理学研究，采纳纳米科技传统则减至25000点；达到50%先出现9105中期发现，继续同一项目到100%才出现9110并获得风暴防护。网站在中期发现之后提供“继续同一项目”的连接，避免读到一半无路可走。七天后女王通过9115来讯；这条路线无需先宣布战争。

中期研究从风暴中取出纳米机器人，发现微型跃迁装置和对传感器的干扰：帝国只能看见女王允许它看见的东西。最终研究转向指令机制，发现机器人会重复上一条命令，直到收到新命令。研究者不能阻止女王继续发令，但能利用指令瘫痪争取优势；这解释了获得防护的叙事依据，并不意味着已经击败她。

9115来讯先要求选择态度，然后可以追问纳米机器来源，或直接结束；追问后只剩结束回应。普通道歉与纳米科技帝国请求教导互斥。请求教导会增加10信任并开启纳米学徒话题，挑衅降低5信任。网站按此顺序显示对话，情境切换仍属于阅读假设，尚未自动继承跨章节传统与信任。


## 数据银行：一个不许追问的委托
女王承认，在帝国附近建立基地是有意为之。她要求取回很久以前失去的数据银行，许诺奖励，却禁止解密，声称其中知识超出了帝国的能力。这使委托同时成为一次服从测试：面对拒绝，她宁可派风暴摧毁缓存，也不愿让别人读到它。

接受任务后，调查者挖出一份埋藏超过十万年、仍有电力的数据银行。可以原样交还，也可以打开；唯物主义帝国另有破解措辞。十四天后，交还者进入奖励对话，打开者读到一条残缺警报：有人急于向大元帅和星球联盟传递消息，女王卫队正在追击，发送者要求阻止她。正文没有完整说明她的计划，不能凭这段残文补写一个未经证实的完整历史。游戏在这里揭示末日倒计时，让读者意识到调查与生存的关联。

读到警报后，非唯物主义帝国十四天后遭到女王质问；唯物主义帝国则进入交付回应。这是原版条件的区别，不应强制所有解密者经历同一场责问。质问开始先损失15信任，随后可以缓和或继续对抗。交付回应先增加10信任，再从科技礼物、常规资源、战略资源、稀有资源四组奖励中选择一种；不是依次领取全部。

拒绝最初委托后，一天后探测到风暴逼近，开启另一项抢救任务。抢先取回数据银行后，可以交还以保全天体，也可以解密；解密分支七天后读到同一份残文，并在回应中毁掉目标天体，十四天后收到女王来讯。抢救失败则先出现天体被风暴摧毁的报告，再于十四天后进入来讯。

普通接受任务后的失败有所不同：它直接进入女王对话，此时目标尚未在这条回调中被摧毁；经过威胁与回应后才发生毁灭。网站因此区分“没有及时取回”和“天体已经毁灭”两类情境。原始项目均要求科研船和科学家，基础研究天数为1800，普通任务期限字段为900、抢救任务为540；这些是脚本参数，具体引擎如何计算期限与研究速度尚未完成核实，本文不据此断言任务无法完成。

这些结尾会标记首次委托结束，女王仍会继续她的计划。一次任务的结束不是整场天灾的结局。

## 随机要求与潜入报告
五类要求并非五个连续任务。人口、资源、科研、普通星系与宜居星系分别提供普通配合、秘密行动和拒绝路线，排外主义另有专属拒绝措辞。只有秘密行动会安排各自的情报报告，通常延迟90–180天，并在报告触发时要求尚未开战。情境选择注明所假设的资格，不模拟帝国全部资源和领土。

资源贡品里的监控设备发现，女王搜集了来自银河各处的人，准备了大量医疗设施，却几乎没有相应食物。这份报告增加调查进展并给出720天的战争准备修正。普通资源供给影响合金产出25%，秘密行动供给影响50%，均持续360天；这不是一次性支付合金的事件。

科研交换让特工短暂进入女王的子处理矩阵，取得她转化为合成形体的记忆：她将追随者的死亡解释为拯救更多人的代价。这里有实质翻译差异：中文写数百人死亡，英文写数百万人；网站保留两份原文，导读不擅自统一。两种配合都会获得360天的研究速度-25%修正，秘密行动后续另加360天的-50%修正与调查进展，不能将它误称为科研奖励。

交出普通星系后，隐藏设备观察到天体被分解、资源耗尽并迅速用于制造舰队。此处中文称舰队从首都启航，英文称前往首都，方向相反；不能据此补写唯一的航行路线。宜居星系报告则描述居民被送进实验设施、智能衰退，卧底随后失联。它要求调查进度至少8以及合格目标，秘密行动还需两个目标；这项牺牲不应在开场就作为人人可选的普通委托。

宜居星系报告同样增加调查进展，并提供720天的进一步战争准备修正。所有这些报告提供的是观察和线索，不是宣战或胜利本身。

## 她为何行动
人口要求中的秘密行动会派出特工。90–180天后、仍未开战时，特工才可能传回报告：被女王关怀的人逐渐失去意识，对言语和触碰不再反应，特工担心自己也将如此。这是来自境内的观察，进一步动摇她关于关怀的说辞；收到报告增加调查进展，并开放人口要求的后续通讯话题，不直接触发战争。

代价也不能忽略：普通配合与秘密行动都会推进女王自己的倒计时，秘密行动推进更多，同时带来调查线索。这里不是单纯“帮助她”或“阻止她”的单向选择，而是在取得证据和让她的计划前进之间承担代价。具体倒计时增量随天灾强度变化，不能写成固定天数。

塞塔娜将终结痛苦称作自己的功能与存在意义。面对帮助，她要求耐心等待召唤；面对威胁，她强调时间已经埋葬过往反对者。她把自己的计划描述为安宁与启蒙，这些措辞属于角色立场，读者应结合其他事件判断其后果。

冷冻舱中的追随者与冰封梦者展示了她和信徒之间的关系。她称赞忠诚，也承认追随者延长生命的尝试失败；谈及被困梦境数千年的埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克时，她表达怜悯，却说对方已不再承担计划中的角色。不要把这些通讯强排成每位玩家必经的连续事件：相关话题需要先发现对应线索。

## 扎克兰与抟土之塑师
在塞塔娜的叙述中，扎克兰先积聚政治和军事力量，最后求助虚境，以自身存在为代价换取对她的囚禁。她将抟土之塑师称作孩子气的魂灵。这里记录的是她对敌人的描述，不是无立场的旁白。

“恶魔？”与“他们不是恶魔。”会得到相同的后续答复，但游戏效果不同：第二种回应要求已突破虚境，并设置可以联系塑造者的标志。普通提问不会得到这个解锁。结束通讯时，还需虚境铸就起源、无轮回之终末契约、无叛徒标志且此前未联系等条件，才转入相应起源事件。

## 对话如何推进
常规话题可以返回后再次询问。星球遭毁、数据银行、人口与星系要求、扎克兰、冷冻舱、冰封梦者、纳米学徒等话题依赖此前经历；完成各自回应后，原版会清除该话题的可用标志。信任奖励也有单独标志防止重复领取，不能把重复问答解释为无限增加信任。

纳米学徒还要求相应话题已解锁、塞塔娜信任超过49。她传授的是纳米提取方法，不是普通通讯自动获得的奖励。

宣战需要先满足调查与风暴防护等条件，并经过表达意图、确认、最终开战三步。中途可以撤回。最终确认后，七天后的回调重组舰队，再向已建立通讯的帝国发出通知；这不是击败塞塔娜的结局。

## 网站中的阅读方式
页面使用“对话情境”选择所假设的外部经历，从常规通讯开始。切换情境会重新开始当前对话。它提供条件分支的阅读入口，不模拟整个存档的信任、科技与全局旗标。
